qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color,

  * Contribute to product thinking, the overall direction of our product, and growing our design culture, not just shipping new features.

product designer. Together, you will form the core of our design function for

**About Mixpanel**

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted
by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products
they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business,
Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what
to build next. Learn more at [mixpanel.com](mixpanel.com).

**About the Team**

The Revenue Operations team at Mixpanel partners with the Regional Business
Leaders to help set and execute global and regional revenue strategies. We
build and execute core operational processes such as business planning and
reporting, facilitate key decision making, work with leadership on crafting
strategies and support ongoing business operations management - whatever is
needed to make our Sales teams successful!

As **Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager**, you will own core business
operations for the region, your job will include in-depth quantitative
analysis of operating metrics with a particular focus on problem-solving and
creating scaled systems and processes. You will work closely with the VP of
North America and cross-functional teams to quickly understand opportunities
and implement solutions.

**Responsibilities**

  * Primary advisor to North America VP on end-to-end Go-To-Market operations
  * Perform strategic product, market, and customer analyses to identify new growth drivers or opportunities for improvement
  * Support annual planning cycles including goaling, coverage model revisions, territory design, and cascading our financial plan
  * Drive continuous improvement through standard operating cadences including weekly forecast and metric reviews in addition to monthly and quarterly go-to-market business reviews
  * Define, manage, and provide insights on key performance indicators across a range of segments, geographies, and go-to-market teams
  * Collaborate with sales, finance, revenue operations, marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to design and execute strategic projects to drive growth, increase sales productivity, operational efficiency, and revenue

  * 3+ years of total work experience in an analytical role (Sales Operations, Business Operations, Management Consulting)

  * Outstanding written and oral communication skills
  * Track-record of collaborating with cross-functional partners to lead transformation and growth

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our
database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and
Vitess+MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and
workloads of all scales.

We also take DX seriously. Our platform enables developers with deep
performance insights, AI integration, powerful cluster management, and schema
migration tooling.

Our customers trust us with what is often their most precious digital asset:
their data. The stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Developer
Educator who is excited about bringing database education to new heights,
creating unique and engaging content, helping customers, and building the
PlanetScale engineering community at conferences, events, and online.

## The job

  * Create technical content to help customers and engineers at-large learn how Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and the PlanetScale ecosystem works
  * Speak at conferences and events, representing PlanetScale in the database and engineering community
  * Create and refine product documentation
  * Host livestreams and webinars to engage with and educate our community
  * Your role may contain between 20-50% travel to connect with developers at events worldwide

## The ideal candidate

  * Teaches complex technical concepts in accessible ways
  * Loves learning about and explaining full-stack application development, databases, and compute infrastructure
  * Is a natural communicator who can adapt your message for different audiences
  * Thrives in community settings and enjoy building relationships with developers
  * Has excellent writing skills and can produce content that engineers actually want to read
  * Is self-motivated and can manage multiple projects independently
  * Enjoys experimenting with new ideas to further the education and marketing mission on PlanetScale

## What you will need

  * 2+ years of experience in engineering, solution architecture, technical education, or developer relations
  * Strong understanding of relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)
  * Proven ability to create technical content (samples of blog posts, tutorials, documentation, or speaking engagements)
  * Experience speaking at conferences or hosting technical presentations and events
  * Willingness to travel between 20-50% of the time

## What else will help you be successful

  * Experience with Vitess or other distributed database technologies
  * Knowledge of distributed systems and database scaling challenges
  * Previous experience at a database or infrastructure company

## Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale. We work with
some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a
Developer Educator, you'll be at the core of educating our customers to
effectively use the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of
millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale’s hiring philosophy is centered
around building small teams of p99 individuals.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work. We
strive to build an environment where people feel that they are respected and
valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee.

## Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where
appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will
be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the
interview process.

postTitle: [全球远程][税前 30-50K/月·12 薪] 招 2 名全栈 AI 原生开发工程师（约 5 年经验）
jobTitle: 全栈 AI 原生开发工程师
descContent:
大家好，我们是一支小型创业团队，正在建设面向全球市场的虚拟卡发行与管理、企业全球账户、钱包及跨境支付相关产品。已有实际业务系统，当前同时推进产品迭代、系统整合，以及可靠性与安全能力建设。现阶段不公开公司、合作机构及模型供应商名称，进入正式沟通后会进一步介绍团队和业务边界。  
  
这次招聘 2 名长期全职的全栈 AI 原生开发工程师。岗位直接汇报 CEO
，并与产品和运营紧密协作。两个名额使用同一岗位标准，会按个人专长形成互补侧重；两个人都需要具备端到端全栈交付能力，不按前端、后端或业务模块切成岗位孤岛。  
  
## 现在主要在做什么  
  
\- 第一优先级：虚拟卡发行与管理平台，包括多合作方能力接入、卡片生命周期、交易同步、钱包账务、风控、对账，以及用户端和运营后台体验。  
\- 第二优先级：AI 工单与运营自动化，包括证据驱动的排障、结构化输出、受控工具调用、评测、脱敏、权限控制、人工审批与审计。  
\- 后续也会参与企业全球账户、稳定币钱包与跨境支付产品的迭代和整合。  
\- 部分系统涉及 EVM / TRON 的充值、归集、链上确认、对账、Webhook 和异常恢复；这不是所有候选人的硬性门槛。  
  
## 我们说的「 AI 原生」  
  
不是简单接一个聊天框，也不只是会用 AI 写代码。  
  
我们会把模型能力真正放进工单诊断和运营流程：让模型在有证据的上下文里生成结构化结果，按权限调用受控工具，并通过评测、观测、脱敏、审计、人工审批和失败降级来约束不确定性。  
  
AI 不能绕过权限、独立执行资金操作或成为高风险变更的最终批准者。涉及卡、钱包、账户和资金的操作必须具备最小权限、人工确认、完整审计和可回退机制。  
  
## 两个名额，互补侧重  
  
\- 产品与支付平台：更偏虚拟卡与支付产品工程，包括多合作方接入、卡片生命周期、交易、钱包、风控、对账、企业账户及前后台完整体验。  
\- AI 自动化与可靠性：更偏 AI 工单、运营流程、评测与受控工具执行，同时参与异步任务、Webhook 、对账、多链能力和异常恢复。  
  
如果你在其中一条主线上明显更强，同时愿意覆盖全栈和生产交付，我们都欢迎。  
  
## 你会做什么  
  
\- 从需求澄清、技术方案、前后端实现、测试、部署到线上观测，对完整业务链路的交付结果负责。  
\- 优先交付虚拟卡平台的用户端、运营后台和服务端能力，覆盖合作方接入、卡片状态、交易、钱包账务、风控和对账。  
\- 建设 AI 工单与运营自动化链路，包括证据检索、结构化诊断、受控工具调用、评测、可观测性、脱敏、人工审批和失败降级。  
\- 负责 API 、数据模型、权限、审计、队列、Webhook 幂等、监控及生产问题定位，确保关键链路可验证、可追踪、可恢复。  
\- 直接与 CEO 、产品和运营把相对模糊的问题收敛为可交付方案，并用文档记录关键判断和取舍。  
  
## 我们希望你具备  
  
\- 通常具有约 5 年软件开发经验；年限不是硬门槛，我们更看重生产系统的独立交付能力。  
\- 具备 TypeScript 全栈能力：Next.js / React 与 Node.js 服务端至少一侧扎实，另一侧能独立完成实际产品开发。  
\- 能独立处理 API 、PostgreSQL 数据模型、鉴权、异步任务、Webhook 、部署和线上排查等常见问题。  
\- 做过真实的 LLM / AI 应用，理解模型输出的不确定性，知道如何通过结构化输出、评测、权限和人工介入进行约束。  
\- 对卡、钱包、账户或其他高风险业务有基本安全意识，重视幂等、审计、数据最小化、脱敏和异常恢复。  
\- 能够在全球远程和模糊需求环境中独立推进，默认以文档、Issue 和代码评审保持上下文。  
\- 中文沟通顺畅，能够阅读和书写英文技术资料，并清楚说明方案背后的判断、限制和取舍。  
  
## 加分项  
  
\- 有发卡、支付、钱包、账务、风控、对账或第三方金融能力接入经验；  
\- 有 Agent 、结构化输出、工具调用、模型评测、AI 可观测性或运营自动化的生产经验；  
\- 熟悉 Redis / BullMQ 、Webhook 可靠性、分布式任务或生产异常恢复；  
\- 了解 EVM / TRON 、充值归集、链上确认或重组处理；  
\- 熟悉 Docker 、Terraform 、CI/CD 、监控与基础安全实践；  
\- 有小团队核心开发经历、开源项目、技术文章或可展示的真实产品。  
  
## 当前技术环境  
  
\- 前端：Next.js 、React 、TypeScript 、Tailwind CSS 、Radix UI  
\- 后端：Node.js / TypeScript 、NestJS / Express 、REST API 、Webhook 、Worker  
\- 数据与任务：PostgreSQL 、Prisma / Supabase 、Redis 、BullMQ  
\- AI：模型 API / Agent 工作流、结构化输出、工具调用、评测、证据追踪、脱敏、审计与人工审批  
\- 交付与质量：Docker 、Terraform 、CI 、自动化测试、日志、监控与可观测性  
\- 业务集成：多合作方卡能力、钱包与对账；部分 EVM / TRON 、ethers 、TronWeb 场景  
  
技术栈不是关键词清单。已有经验有帮助，但只要基础扎实、能快速上手，我们不会要求每一项都完全一致。  
  
## 薪资与工作方式  
  
\- 招聘人数：2 人  
\- 汇报对象：CEO ；日常直接与 CEO 、产品和运营协作  
\- 工作方式：全球远程；长期全职合同制合作，非兼职或按项目计费外包  
\- 固定月薪：税前人民币 30-50K ，按 12 个月支付；具体根据经验、能力和匹配度确定  
\- 试用期：试用期同薪  
\- 奖金 / 期权：如有则另行约定，不计入人民币 30-50K 的固定月薪区间  
\- 时间重叠：CEO 位于欧洲中部时区 CET/CEST （随夏令时调整）；工作日每天至少 4 小时重叠  
\- 沟通方式：中文为主，需英文技术读写；异步文档为默认方式，每周 2-3 次同步会议  
  
说明：这是全球远程的长期全职合同制合作，不等同于候选人所在地的直接劳动雇佣；跨境结算、税务责任、休假、设备及生产事件响应等，以初步沟通和正式合同为准。  
  
## 面试流程  
  
1\. 初步沟通（约 30 分钟）：相互介绍团队、产品和岗位，了解经历与求职预期。  
2\. 项目与技术交流（约 60-90 分钟）：围绕真实项目聊架构、关键决策、失败和线上结果，并讨论卡 / 支付、AI 工作流与全栈生产问题。  
3\. CEO / 团队沟通：对齐业务目标、远程协作方式、入职预期、薪资和合同条件，并留出充分提问时间。  
  
## 如何联系  
  
请发送到： [hechenxia@aipowerlabs.io](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)  
  
邮件标题建议：V2EX - AI Fullstack - 姓名  
  
请附上以下信息：  
  
1\. 所在国家 / 地区、时区，以及每天可与 CET/CEST 重叠的时间；  
2\. 简历、GitHub 、个人主页、作品或技术文章链接；  
3\. 1-2 个最有代表性的项目：解决了什么问题、你实际负责什么、做过哪些关键决策、上线后结果如何；  
4\. 一个生产环境 AI / Agent 案例；如果没有，也可以说明最相关的系统经验；  
5\. 期望薪资和最早可入职时间。  
  
不需要提供无法公开的前公司代码或敏感资料；能够把背景、架构、个人职责和关键取舍讲清楚即可。我们会认真回复匹配的候选人，也欢迎在帖子下面直接提问。谢谢。

descContent:
## **Position: Account Manager – Client Services**

****Important**:** This role requires at least five years of firsthand
experience living and working in the United States, polished and natural
spoken and written English, and a strong understanding of U.S. business
culture and client expectations. Applicants who do not meet these requirements
will not be considered.

**Location:** Fully Remote / Work From Anywhere  
**Schedule:** US Central Time, Monday–Friday (Full-Time)  
**Compensation:** $2,500–$3,500/month

## **  
Overview**

Integrated Hire (integratedhire.com) helps small and mid-sized U.S. businesses
build high-performing remote teams by connecting them with experienced
offshore professionals across administration, finance, customer service,
marketing, operations, and more.

We’re looking for a Client Services and Client Success Manager who is highly
organized, responsive, and excellent at keeping clients happy. This is not
primarily a sales role. The focus is on onboarding, client communication,
follow-up, problem solving, and making sure the client experience stays smooth
from the moment a client signs through the hiring process and beyond.

A significant part of this role involves stepping in when things do not go
according to plan. You may be handling an unhappy client, employee performance
or attendance concerns, communication breakdowns, or other unexpected issues.
You’ll take ownership, coordinate with the right people internally, and help
drive each situation toward a resolution.

This role is best suited for someone who is calm under pressure, strong with
follow-through, comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients, and able to
manage many moving pieces without letting anything fall through the cracks.

We’re open to experienced professionals based anywhere in the United States or
abroad, provided they can consistently work U.S. business hours and
communicate naturally and confidently with U.S. business owners.

## **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Client Issue Resolution & Problem Solving**

  * Take ownership of client issues and drive them through resolution
  * Manage situations involving employee performance, attendance, communication problems, client dissatisfaction, replacements, and other service issues
  * Communicate directly with clients to understand concerns, set expectations, and determine next steps
  * Coordinate with recruitment, leadership, and other team members to resolve problems quickly
  * Handle sensitive or difficult conversations professionally while maintaining strong client relationships

#### **Client Onboarding & Handover**

  * Lead or join onboarding calls after a new client signs and manage a smooth handover from sales to delivery
  * Confirm and document client requirements, expectations, and timelines for the internal team
  * Set the tone for a professional, organized client experience from day one

#### **Client Communication & Retention**

  * Serve as the main point of contact for clients through recruitment, placement, and beyond
  * Run regular check-ins and updates on search progress, interviews, and next steps
  * Answer client questions with clear guidance on process, documentation, and timelines
  * Stay proactive after hires are made by flagging concerns, risks, and expansion opportunities
  * Keep clients seeing Integrated Hire as a reliable long-term partner

#### **Interview & Recruitment Coordination**

  * Coordinate interview scheduling between clients, candidates, and recruiters
  * Monitor client interviews to ensure attendance
  * Jump in on scheduling, access, or technical issues in real time
  * Collect post-interview feedback and share it clearly with the team

## **What We’re Looking For**

### **Required**

  * 3+ years in client success, account management, operations, recruitment coordination, or a similar client-facing role
  * Experience working with U.S.-based clients or companies
  * Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  * Strong organization and follow-through across multiple clients, tasks, and conversations
  * Comfortable leading client calls and handling difficult or sensitive conversations professionally
  * Strong judgment and problem-solving ability when dealing with unhappy clients, employee issues, or situations without an obvious answer
  * High attention to detail with documentation, scheduling, and process management
  * Proactive, dependable, and able to take ownership without needing constant reminders

### **Preferred**

  * Experience in staffing, HR, recruitment, outsourcing, BPO, or remote team management
  * Experience supporting SMB clients in the U.S.
  * Familiarity with CRM, ATS, project management, or client communication tools
  * Experience coordinating interviews, onboarding, or service delivery processes
  * Experience handling client escalations, employee performance issues, or other high-touch problem resolution
  * Background in operations, executive support, or customer success  
  

## **Why Join Us**

  * Fully remote – work from anywhere in the U.S. or abroad
  * True location flexibility
  * Work directly with founders and senior team members
  * Play a key role in improving client experience and retention
  * Fast-growing company with strong opportunity for advancement

**About Versapay**

  

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

  

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes
friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance
leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

  

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and
reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and
business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over
10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay
processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

  

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

  

  

  

  

**How you’ll make an impact here – and on your career:**

  

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking,
customer empathy, and strong execution. As **Senior Product Manager,
Payments** , you will own the **end-to-end payments product and experience** ,
from customer-facing workflows through underlying processing, settlement, and
partner integrations.

In this role, you will be accountable for the vision, strategy, and delivery
of our payments capabilities, with a particular focus on our payment
processing gateway and broader payments ecosystem. You will operate with a
holistic mindset—owning outcomes across reliability, usability, scalability,
and commercial performance—rather than isolated features.

This role pairs deep payments domain ownership with modern product management
practices. You will lead end-to-end product development, drive customer and
business value through data-informed decisions, and collaborate across
engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and
innovative payments experiences. You will also regularly represent the
payments product strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing
direction and investment decisions.

This is an opportunity for a product leader who thrives in complexity, is
energized by ambiguity, and is excited to help grow and modernize a global
payments platform.

### What you'll do:

    * **Product Strategy & Vision **
    * Own and articulate a clear product vision and strategy for payments, aligned with company objectives and growth plans. 
    * Take a holistic view of the end-to-end payments experience, ensuring customer, operational, and platform considerations are tightly integrated. 
    * Define and evolve the payments roadmap, balancing customer needs, regulatory requirements, operational scalability, and commercial outcomes. 
    * Stay current on industry trends, emerging payment methods, and competitive offerings to inform strategy and prioritization. 
    * Identify opportunities for cross-product alignment, standardization, and platform unification across the broader product portfolio. 

**End-to-End Product Ownership**

    * Lead payments products through the full product development lifecycle, from discovery and ideation through launch and continuous improvement. 
    * Partner closely with engineering and design to translate customer problems into well-defined requirements, epics, and user stories. 
    * Prioritize the product backlog based on customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility. 
    * Drive high-quality execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining a strong bias toward action

**Payments Domain Leadership**

    * Serve as the subject-matter expert for payments, including payment gateways, processors, payment facilitators, settlement, and funding flows. 
    * Own integrations and relationships with major processors and partners (e.g., **Adyen** , Fiserv, Global Payments). 
    * Ensure products are built with a strong understanding of payments operations, risk, compliance, and scalability. 
    * Help shape the future of our payments infrastructure to support global growth. 

**Customer & Market Insight **

    * Be the expert on the customer: deeply understand who is using our payments products, what problems they are trying to solve, and how success is measured. 
    * Conduct market research, customer interviews, and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate solutions. 
    * Design hypotheses and experiments to test assumptions and drive learning. 

**Data-Driven Decision Making**

    * Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success across adoption, revenue, reliability, and customer outcomes. 
    * Use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to inform prioritization and identify areas for improvement. 
    * Present product strategy, progress, and performance to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. 

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence **

    * Lead and influence cross-functional teams across engineering, design, sales, marketing, professional services, and customer success. 
    * Act as the primary point of contact for payments products, aligning internal teams and external partners around shared goals. 
    * Facilitate agile ceremonies and ensure teams are focused on delivering the highest-impact outcomes. 

**Go-To-Market & Adoption **

    * Partner with go-to-market teams to define value propositions, pricing inputs, and launch strategies for payments capabilities. 
    * Create internal and customer-facing documentation, training materials, and presentations to support successful launches. 
    * Drive adoption and ongoing success of payments products post-launch. 

**Leadership & Craft Excellence **

    * Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture focused on customer value and continuous improvement. 
    * Mentor and influence other product managers, helping elevate the craft of product management across the organization. 
    * Operate effectively in a complex environment, making timely decisions while managing tradeoffs. 

### What you'll bring to the team

    * **Required Qualifications**
    * 5+ years of experience in product management, including ownership of complex, user-facing digital products. 
    * Proven experience building, launching, and scaling payments or fintech products. 
    * Strong understanding of payments ecosystems, including gateways, processors, payment facilitators, and settlement flows. 
    * Demonstrated ability to communicate product strategy and results to senior leadership, including experience presenting to executive audiences. 
    * Experience working with cross-functional teams in an agile development environment. 
    * Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into clear product direction and execution. 
    * Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to inform decisions. 
    * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity for technical and non-technical audiences. 

**Education**

    * Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. 
    * MBA or advanced degree is a plus. 
    * Tools & Ways of Working 
    * Experience with product and delivery tools such as Jira and product analytics platforms (e.g., Heap, Mixpanel, Amplitude). 
    * Comfort working with APIs, data, and complex systems at scale. 

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Nice to Have)**

    * Experience with ISO standards and payment facilitator operations. 
    * Technical understanding of payment frameworks and data models. 
    * Experience operating in highly regulated or global payments environments. 
    * Builder mentality: entrepreneurial, adaptable, and comfortable defining net-new initiatives in ambiguous spaces.

## Company Description

Are you passionate about building robust, high-performance data platforms?
Join us as a Data Engineer and work on an innovative solution in the interior
decor industry.

We at Sigma Software create cutting-edge digital products that transform
industries, and this project is no exception. You will be part of a team that
combines technology and design to deliver a unique visualization experience
for customers. Why join us? You’ll work with modern data engineering tools,
enjoy professional growth opportunities, and be part of a supportive,
knowledge-sharing culture.

**CUSTOMER**  
  
Our client operates in the interior decor sector, delivering innovative
digital solutions that enhance the shopping experience. Their advanced
visualization tools allow customers to preview furniture and decor items in
realistic settings, helping them make confident purchasing decisions. The
company blends technology with design expertise to transform how people shop
for their homes.

**PROJECT**  
  
The project focuses on building a high-performance data platform to support an
advanced interior visualization product. This solution enables real-time
rendering of home decor items in various styles and environments, powered by
robust ELT pipelines and centralized data warehousing. The team works closely
with product managers, machine learning engineers, and data scientists to
ensure data-driven insights and seamless user experiences.

## Job Description

  * Design, build, and optimize high-volume, high-performance ELT pipelines for centralized data warehousing
  * Collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and DevOps to define and enforce a reliable, scalable, and secure data platform architecture
  * Ensure adherence to data warehousing standards, data quality best practices, and metadata management processes
  * Take responsibility for assigned data warehouse components, contributing to enhancements in performance and reliability
  * Conduct architecture reviews and participate in system design discussions to provide technical input
  * Support and collaborate with peers, sharing knowledge and promoting a culture of quality and continuous learning

## Qualifications

  * At least 3-4 years of experience in data engineering, building scalable data systems and pipelines
  * Strong SQL skills
  * Working proficiency in Python
  * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines and working with a data warehouse or analytics stack
  * Strong computer science fundamentals
  * Knowledge of system architecture with emphasis on reliability, availability, and performance
  * Focus on delivering production-ready solutions
  * Attention to detail and commitment to data quality
  * Clear communication skills
  * Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  * Upper-Intermediate level of spoken and written English

## Additional Information

**PERSONAL PROFILE**

  * Proactive and detail-oriented approach
  * Ability to take ownership of complex data systems
  * Passion for data quality and continuous improvement
  * Strong mentoring and collaboration skills
  * Adaptability in fast-paced project environments

* * *

## Your mission

As a key member of our Engineering team, you won't just be writing code—you'll
be solving complex problems and taking full ownership of features from concept
to deployment. You will have a direct impact on a product used by thousands of
construction professionals to build the world around us.

In your first few months, you might:

  * Design and build new AI features, such as our recently launched AI agent for editing BoQs or automated AI bidder recommendations

  * Collaborate with product managers and designers to shape the user experience and technical direction of our core product.

  * Architect and implement modular packages and services in our monorepo to improve the structure and maintainability of our codebase

## How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment.
We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our
approach includes:

  * Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.

  * Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.

  * DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.

  * Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

## Your profile

We're looking for an experienced engineer who is passionate about building
great products. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  * Significant professional experience building, shipping, and maintaining complex web applications using TypeScript.

  * Deep expertise in Node.js for backend development and a strong command of React for the frontend.

  * A pragmatic approach to problem-solving and a high sense of ownership, feeling comfortable driving projects independently.

  * Experience working in collaborative, agile product teams.

  * Excellent communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For (Nice-to-Haves):

  * Experience with our infrastructure stack (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform).

  * Experience with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

  * An interest in data engineering or machine learning.

## Why us?

  * Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  * Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  * Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  * A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  * Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

## About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction
industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders
and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in
the industry with innovation and simplicity.

**Why Cosuno?**

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of
price data points and helps construction companies create precise and
efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them
avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive
it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the
construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best
ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work
environment is a matter of course for us.

**Join us – Build the future of construction.**

##### What to expect

  

  

Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir entwickeln
Lösungen, die eine moderne, datengestützte Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen
und die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Zuhause schlagen. Unsere App bietet
Patient*innen die Freiheit, ihre Nachsorge zeitlich flexibel und
ortsunabhängig zu gestalten – individuell begleitet durch unser
therapeutisches Team.

Als Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten) gestaltest du die digitale
Transformation im deutschen Gesundheitswesen aktiv mit. Deine Arbeit hat
unmittelbaren Impact, denn jedes Feature, das du entwickelst, zahlt direkt auf
den Genesungsweg von Menschen ein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design,
Engineering und Data durchläufst du alle Facetten eines modernen Produktzyklus
– von der ersten Hypothese bis zum Release. Du arbeitest hands-on mit
Prototypen, nutzt Experimente zum Lernen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit
unseren Nutzer*innen. So erlebst du unmittelbar, welchen wertvollen
Unterschied deine Arbeit für das Leben von Patient:innen und die
Zukunftsfähigkeit unseres Gesundheitssystems macht.

Diese Rolle ist perfekt für dich, wenn...

  * ...du den direkten Kontakt liebst: Wöchentliche Nutzerinterviews sind für dich kein Pflichttermin, sondern deine wichtigste Inspirationsquelle

  * ...du Geschwindigkeit schätzt: Schnelles Prototyping und Shipping motivieren dich mehr als monatelange Konzeptionsphasen

  * ...du mutig entscheidest: Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, auch bei unvollständiger Datenlage die Richtung vorzugeben und durch Iteration zu lernen

  

  
  
  

##### Your Challenges

  

  

  * Werde zur Stimme unserer Nutzer*innen: Du führst eigenständig Interviews mit Patient*innen und sprichst regelmäßig mit Ärzt*innen und Kliniken. Du tauchst tief in ihre Lebensrealität ein, analysierst ihre Herausforderungen und übersetzt echte Gespräche in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, die den Genesungsweg spürbar verbessern

  * Gestalte die Therapie von morgen: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie mit Experimenten und Prototypen – und baust gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering echte Lösungen, die in unserer App live gehen. Du begleitest Features vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Release und darüber hinaus

  * Wachse in die Verantwortung für deinen Squad: Gemeinsam mit Design, Tech und Medizin moderierst du den Weg von der ersten Idee bis zum Release. Du lernst, wie man Klarheit schafft und Hindernisse aus dem Weg räumt, damit ihr am Ende gemeinsam den Erfolg eurer Arbeit feiern könnt

  * Sorge für Transparenz und Vertrauen: Du kommunizierst Fortschritte und Hürden offen. Dein Ziel ist es, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen und eine Basis zu schaffen, auf der wir unsere Produktvision Schritt für Schritt gemeinsam in die Realität umsetzen

  * Arbeite datengetrieben und zeige Impact: Du definierst Erfolgskriterien, analysierst Metriken und ziehst klare Schlüsse aus Nutzer- und Produktdaten. Deine Insights fließen direkt in Entscheidungen ein und helfen uns, Impact messbar zu machen – für Patient:innen, Kliniken und das Unternehmen

  * Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

  * Übernehme Ownership für Engagement, Verständlichkeit und Fortschritt im Patient:innen-Erlebnis: Du identifizierst zentrale Paint Points, priorisiert datenbasiert und setzt gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering konkrete Verbesserungen um - mit dem Ziel einer stabilen, klaren und motivierenden App-Experience

  * Messbarer Impact:In den ersten 3-6 Monaten baust du ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Patient:innen auf, definierst klare Erfolgskriterien und bringst erste Features oder Optimierungen live, die spürbare Verbesserungen Nutzungsverhalten zeigen

  
  
  

  
  
  

##### Your profile

  

  

  * Erste PM-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits in agilen Teams gearbeitet und dabei geholfen, nutzerzentrierte digitale Produkte zum Erfolg zu führen

  * Leidenschaft fürs Bauen & neue Technologien: Du liebst es, Dinge einfach auszuprobieren – ob durch Prototyping, Experimente oder „Vibe Coding“. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools und Automatisierung ganz natürlich als Hebel, um schneller zu validieren und smarte Lösungen zu bauen

  * Analytisches Köpfchen: Du hast Spaß daran, Daten zu interpretieren und als Kompass für deine Entscheidungen zu nutzen

  * Pragmatismus & Problemlösung: Komplexe Situationen schrecken dich nicht ab. Du strukturierst das Chaos und findest Lösungen, die im echten Alltag (Klinik/Patient) funktionieren

  * Hands-on-Mentalität: Du lernst am liebsten durch Machen. Schnell etwas veröffentlichen, Feedback einsammeln und iterieren ist genau dein Rhythmus

  * Kommunikationsstark: Du bewegst dich sicher in einem internationalen Team und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch

  
  

  
  
  

##### Why Caspar Health?

  

  

  * Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands

  * Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top

  * Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr 

  * Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  * Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!

  * Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!

  * Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!

  * Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

## Was uns als Team ausmacht

  * Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag

  * Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur

  * Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft

  * Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

### Lust, Gesundheit neu zu denken?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil von Caspar Health. Gemeinsam machen wir den
Unterschied.

  

  
  
  

##### Your contact

  

  

Elisabeth Hegele; Talent Acquisition Specialist

Außerdem sind wir an deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deinen
Gehaltsvorstellungen interessiert. Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, wende
dich bitte an [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection). Wir werden uns
so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen.

Unser Produkt CASPAR Health wird im Umfeld von medizinischen Einrichtungen,
Patient*innen, Ärzt*innen und Therapeut*innen eingesetzt. Zu unserem
beruflichen Alltag gehört es, mit (sensiblen) personenbezogenen Daten (z.B.
Gesundheitsdaten) zu arbeiten. Daher fordern wir von unseren Mitarbeiter*innen
ein hohes Commitment zum Schutz personenbezogener Daten ein, um die Rechte der

Bei Caspar Health sind wir bestrebt, für alle Casparianer*innen eine

Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung,
Einschränkungen aller Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialer Herkunft, Alter

findest Du [hier](https://caspar-health.com/de-de/datenschutz).

  

  
  
  

##### About us

  

  

Caspar Health is a digital rehabilitation clinic with a vision to provide
patients with access to the most effective rehabilitation treatment at any
time, any place.

Medical facilities use Caspar Health to conduct therapy measures online with
their patients during their hospital stay and after discharge. The combination
of learning technology with in-depth medical knowledge ensures that the

The services are covered by numerous pension insurance companies in the areas
of rehabilitation, prevention and aftercare.

live a travel-rich lifestyle through the power of community.** By exchanging
primary residences with trusted peers, renters and owners alike can match with
Kindred spirits and explore new destinations without breaking the bank.

Kindred is revolutionizing the “third option” of travel accommodation,
compared to short-term rentals and hotels. Since launching in 2022, Kindred
has grown to a global community of 300,000 members across 150+ cities and puts
home swapping on the map as a radically more affordable, responsible, and
connected way to travel.

To support that momentum, Kindred has raised over $150M in capital from some
of the most credible investors in Silicon Valley, including Index Ventures,
Andreessen Horowitz, New Enterprise Associates, Bessemer Venture Partners,
Caffeinated Capital, Elad Gil, and founders of companies like Opendoor, Figma,
ClassPass, and more.

Kindred’s co-founders are proven leaders from the early team at Opendoor
($15B+ exit), who have each built and scaled products that today generate $1B+
annual revenue combined.

We’re looking for the world’s top builders, executors, and believers to help
us make travel more meaningful.

You can learn more about us in
[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/francescawalton/2026/02/03/home-swap-
startup-kindred-raises-125-million-in-fresh-funding-as-travelers-seek-
creative-ways-to-save-money/) and [The New York
Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/16/realestate/is-your-apartment-nice-
enough-for-this-home-swapping-app.html).

## **The Role:**

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of travel.
This is a high-impact, strategic role where you'll work closely with our co-
founders and a full-stack team to solve complex, deeply human challenges—like
how to make hosting your personal home feel natural, how to scale a community
without compromising quality, and how to create systems that serve both sides
of a marketplace.

We’re looking for someone with deep consumer intuition and empathy and an
exceptionally user-centric approach to problem-solving. This is fast-paced,
intellectually demanding, and emotionally meaningful work—with the potential

**Payabli** is a next-generation Payments Infrastructure and Monetization
Platform purpose-built for vertical software companies. Through a single,
developer-friendly API with low-code embedded payment components, Payabli
enables platforms to seamlessly embed, monetize, and operationalize
payments—making payments a core part of their platform and business model.

By unifying payment acceptance, payment issuance, and advanced payment
operations tooling, Payabli empowers software companies to manage and move
money through a single infrastructure stack that delivers total control over
the payments experience. Built to scale with PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2-compliant
security, Payabli’s infrastructure delivers enterprise-grade reliability and
trust while leveraging AI-driven intelligence to enhance visibility,
streamline operations, and drive revenue growth.

Backed by leading fintech investors including QED Investors, Fika Ventures,
TTV Capital, and Bling Capital, Payabli is setting the standard for embedded
payments infrastructure powering the next generation of vertical SaaS.

We're seeking a **Senior****Product Manager, Platform** to own and evolve the
foundational services that every product at Payabli depends on. From identity
and authentication to embedded components, tokenization, and notification
systems—you'll be the connective tissue between engineering and the rest of
the organization, ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, and built to
last.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage from the sidelines. You'll
run to the fire, own the outcomes, and build the infrastructure that makes
everything else at Payabli possible.

## **What You'll Do**

  * **Identity & Access Management **Lead the strategy and execution of our identity platform, spanning both authentication and authorization. You'll define how users and API consumers prove who they are and what they're allowed to do—two fundamentally different problems that require distinct architectures. This includes SSO management, multi-tenant permissions models, and API authentication and authorization. You understand that identity is the front door to every product we build.

  * **Embedded Components & Creator Suite **Own the foundational suite of embeddable components that our platform partners use to build financial experiences. You'll drive the strategy for our component library—from white-labeled UI elements to drop-in workflows—ensuring our partners can go live faster with less engineering effort. This requires experience building embeddable systems and a deep appreciation for developer experience.

  * **Tokenization Services** Own the cross-cutting tokenization layer that serves multiple product lines. Tokenization underpins payment security, funding account protection, and data privacy across the entire platform. You'll work across teams to ensure a unified approach to sensitive data handling that scales with our growth and meets compliance requirements.

  * **Communications & Compliance **Own the notification system and communication channels that keep our platform running. This includes managing SMS as a channel—including 10DLC compliance in the US—email delivery, and other messaging infrastructure. You understand that communication channels aren't just features; they're regulated services that require proper compliance management and ongoing maintenance.

  * **Logging, Observability & Data **Drive the platform's logging infrastructure, observability capabilities, and data dashboard foundations. You'll ensure that internal teams and platform partners have the visibility they need to operate with confidence—from debugging transaction flows to monitoring system health and building meaningful analytics.

  * **API Ecosystem & Developer Experience **Champion the overall health and usability of our API ecosystem. You'll partner with engineering on API design, versioning, governance, and documentation—ensuring that both internal teams and external partners can build reliably on our platform. The developer experience is your product.

## **What We're Looking For**

• 5+ years in product management with deep experience in platform,
infrastructure, or developer-facing products

• Hands-on experience building and maintaining foundational platform services
(identity/auth, APIs, SDKs, notification systems, or similar)

• Track record of shipping API-first products in a B2B SaaS or multi-tenant
environment

• Experience with authentication and authorization systems (OAuth, SSO,
RBAC/ABAC, API key management)

• Familiarity with embeddable/white-label component systems and developer
experience optimization

• Experience working in regulated industries (fintech, payments, banking, or
financial infrastructure) is a strong plus

• Understanding of tokenization, data security, and PCI compliance concepts

• Ability to partner deeply with engineering on API design, data models, and
system architecture

• Understanding of cloud identity services (AWS Cognito, Auth0, or similar)
and their tradeoffs

• (Nice to have) Familiarity with messaging compliance (10DLC, carrier
regulations) and communication channel management

**We think you'll love being part of our team because**

At Payabli, you'll have a front row seat into building a high-growth venture
backed fintech company. As a senior leader in Operations, you'll shape how the
organization scales and be the driving force behind our AI-first operations
strategy — directly influencing how we build, automate, and optimize for the
future. You'll stretch yourself every day, learn a ton, grow alongside the
company, and have a lot of fun building Payabli with us. We're a values driven
company that cares deeply about our team, partners, and customers. Our north
star values are:

**Team Love = Customer Love** — You understand that when you build great
products for your internal partners, they deliver exceptional experiences to
merchants. You obsess over the platform partners and businesses that depend on
every payout landing on time.

**Run to the Fire** — When ACH returns spike or a card program hits a snag,
you're the first one in the war room. You don't shy away from hard
problems—you chase them. You volunteer for the complex, messy challenges
others avoid.

**Little Things Count** — You sweat the details because you know a single
decimal error in a payout can damage a business. You double-check edge cases,
validate every assumption, and understand that excellence lives in the
details.

**Truth Seekers** — You give direct feedback, receive it with grace, and never
let ego get in the way of finding the right answer. You document what you
don't know, admit mistakes quickly, and hold yourself accountable in the open.

**Relentlessly Curious** — You're constantly asking "what if?" and "why not?"
You study how competitors solve problems, explore adjacent industries for
inspiration, and never stop learning about the payments ecosystem.

We build technology that gets noticed and a workplace where people want to
grow their careers.. Our work has been recognized by some of the industry’s
most respected organizations, including the **2026 Forbes Fintech 50 list** ,
which highlights the most innovative private companies in financial
technology, **Inc.’s 2025 Best Workplaces** , and **Built In’s 2026 Best
Places to Work in Miami.**

## **What we can offer you**

  * Competitive salary

  * Stock options with the potential to unlock more equity as we grow

  * Flexible PTO and paid parental leave

  * Medical, dental, & vision insurance

  * 401K, HSA, pre-tax savings programs

**Payabli** is an equal opportunity employer and values a diverse, inclusive
workplace.

**Principals only**. No external agency submissions. Candidates must apply
directly; We will not accept submissions from third-party recruiters or
staffing agencies.

* * *

**What excites you**

  * You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out.

  * You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior.

  * You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop.

  * You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI.

  * You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why.

**What excites us**

  * You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces.

  * You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work.

  * You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch.

  * You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed.

  * You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes.

  * You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them.

  * Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels.

**Working at Folio**

  * We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners.

  * We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day.

  * You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for.

  * We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up

**What we value**

  * **Craft**. We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace.

  * **Optimism**. We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit.

  * **Ownership**. We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together.

  * **Hospitality.** The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day.

**Who are we?**

Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and
deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI
systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search,
RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread
adoption of AI.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing
to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our
customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our
customers.

Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are
passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at
what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement
for building great products.

Join us on our mission and shape the future!

#

# **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Platform Experience and Developer PM to own how developers
and enterprise technical teams build on, integrate with, and operate Cohere's
model platform.

This is a high-leverage role sitting at the intersection of three domains:

**Managed Services and Models as a Service.** Own Cohere's managed service
offerings as a product. This is broader than model serving alone. It includes
the full range of how enterprises consume and operate Cohere's capabilities,
from shared multi-tenant model access to dedicated single-tenant deployments,
and from synchronous real-time inference to high-volume asynchronous
workloads. You will own the product thinking around deployment models, data
residency and regional compliance requirements, self-serve provisioning, and
the operational controls that give enterprises confidence in running
production workloads on Cohere’s infrastructure.

**API and SDK.** Own the roadmap for how developers build on Cohere. This
means setting the direction for our APIs and SDKs, thinking carefully about
interface design and ergonomics, and ensuring we ship developer primitives
that are stable, well-documented, and a joy to build with.

**Developer Experience and Tooling.** Own the surfaces that give developers
visibility and control over their integration with Cohere. This includes the
API console, credential and access management, usage and cost visibility,
request observability, and sandbox and testing environments

# **Responsibilities**

  * Drive the roadmap across managed services, APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term platform investment.

  * Translate model and infrastructure capabilities into well-designed product surfaces that developers and enterprise operators can rely on.

  * Engage directly with customers and developers to understand integration challenges, validate priorities, and surface unmet needs.

  * Define success metrics for platform health and developer experience, and lead initiatives to move them.

  * Partner with engineering, research, technical writing, and developer relations to ship and document platform improvements.

# **Requirements**

  * 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent owning developer-facing or platform-layer products such as APIs, SDKs, developer tools, or technical infrastructure.

  * Strong technical fluency with API design and SDK development, including an understanding of versioning, backward compatibility, and what makes a developer experience feel polished and reliable.

  * A track record of thinking about infrastructure as a product, with the ability to translate system-level capabilities into clearly differentiated, customer-facing features.

  * Experience building or owning developer tooling surfaces such as consoles, dashboards, usage analytics, or observability and debugging tools.

  * Analytical by default: you define success metrics before you build, instrument thoughtfully, and use data alongside qualitative feedback to make decisions.

  * Strong collaborator who works well across engineering, design, infrastructure, and GTM teams, and who can communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to a range of stakeholders.

  * Highly execution-oriented with a bias toward shipping and iterating quickly.

  * Demonstrated ownership across the full product lifecycle — from problem definition and scoping through launch, iteration, and eventual deprecation or migration.

# **Nice-to-Haves**

  * Experience owning a model serving or inference platform, including familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant and dedicated infrastructure.

  * Exposure to data residency, sovereignty, or regional compliance requirements as they apply to AI or cloud infrastructure products.

  * Familiarity with asynchronous and high-throughput workload patterns, and the product considerations they introduce around job management, status visibility, and cost attribution.

  * Familiarity with the AI developer ecosystem and open standards, including orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, model serving frameworks such as vLLM, and an awareness of de facto interoperability standards and how they shape developer adoption and integration patterns.

# **Why join Cohere?**

  * Impact: Shape the developer surface of one of the world's leading enterprise AI platforms, used by developers and enterprises building production AI systems at scale.

  * Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges at the frontier of AI.

  * Growth: Enjoy competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development.

  * Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Toronto.

Remote or hybrid (San Francisco, New York, Toronto).

If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still
encourage you to apply!

We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work
environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are

descContent:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend
less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we
create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier,
faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.  

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting,
so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling
stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally.
Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly
believe in our mission.  

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in
the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with
curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves
what they do, we'd love to meet you.  

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.  

**About the Role**

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.  

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led
content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What
we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the
money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually
say, and how we prove any of it worked.  

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster,
and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and
campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be
working across US time zones on a regular basis.  

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times
further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good
answers.  

**What You'll Do**

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to
end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't
working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and
TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the
program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador
structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial
and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence
rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including
whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to
timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so
creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running
beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and
major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community,
events, and podcast partnerships.  

**What You'll Bring**

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an
agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather
than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to
walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort
operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and
negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and
persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the
relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes
persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view
on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN,
CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, [Impact.com](http://Impact.com),
PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in
slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

**Nice to have, genuinely not required**

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

_We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator
programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook
travels._

**What You'll Gain**

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and
no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate
about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.  

**What Happens After You Apply?**

  1. **Phone Screen** â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. **Team Interview** â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. **Case Discussion** â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. **Bar-Raiser Interview** â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. **Offer!** â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

We are seeking a dynamic and pragmatic Scrum Master to join our diverse global

Some experience as a Scrum Master with an awareness of one or more Agile
methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban or XP will be useful to succeed in this
role. Transferable experience from different career paths is welcomed.

give examples of their pragmatic and outcome-driven approach. A positive and
constructive attitude towards setbacks is essential for this role. The ideal
candidate will be ready to give examples of their resilience and creativity
when facing challenges. Due to the international nature of the team and the
business, experience working in a multicultural setting would be beneficial.

decisions. Over 9,000 paid customers, including companies like Netflix,

negotiate key deals and relationships and act as a trusted business partner

house for global businesses, executing and negotiating commercial transactions

、日志、指标、调用链等信息快速定位生产环境问题。

延迟、缓存命中率、数据库慢查询、消息堆积等问题进行快速分析和定位。  
参与大数据及实时数据处理相关系统建设，负责海量日志、用户行为、订单、风控事件等数据的采集、处理、分析及查询架构设计。

参与 Doris / Elasticsearch / ClickHouse

积极使用 AI 提升研发效率，包括 AI Coding 、代码分析、问题排查、技术方案设计、测试生成、日志分析等场景。  
  
任职要求  
核心要求  
5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Go 开发经验，具备扎实的 Go 语言基础，熟悉 Goroutine 、Channel 、Context 、网络编程及
Go 服务性能优化。  
具备较强的 系统架构设计能力，有实际负责大型分布式系统、高并发系统或核心业务系统架构设计和落地经验。  
有丰富的 CDN + 应用缓存 + Redis 多级缓存架构经验，理解缓存一致性、热点数据、缓存穿透/击穿/雪崩等问题。  
有大型企业 统一入口 / 统一接入平台建设经验，熟悉 API Gateway 、流量治理、限流、熔断、服务发现、健康检查、故障切换等。  
有完整的 生产环境监控和可观测性体系建设经验，能够从 0 到 1 设计和建设一套覆盖基础设施、网络、网关、应用、数据库、中间件及业务指标的监控体系。  
具备较强的 线上问题快速定位能力，能够通过 Metrics 、Logs 、Traces
、调用链、系统指标及业务指标，快速判断问题所在层级，并建立从“发现问题 → 告警 → 定位 → 分析 → 处理 → 复盘”的完整闭环。  
有 OpenTelemetry 或同类可观测性体系的实际使用经验，理解 Metrics 、Logs 、Traces 、TraceID 、Span
、Context Propagation 等概念。  
具备较好的 大数据系统经验，有海量日志、实时数据、用户行为分析、风控、监控或数据分析平台的实际项目经验。

Doris

ClickHouse

有大型互联网、金融、电商、支付、广告、内容平台等高并发业务经验。  
熟悉 Kafka 、Pulsar 等消息队列的大规模生产实践。  
熟悉 Kubernetes 、Docker 、云原生及微服务体系。  
熟悉 Prometheus 、Grafana 、Loki 、Tempo 、Jaeger 等监控及可观测性组件。  
熟悉 MySQL / PostgreSQL ，并具备数据库性能优化经验。  
有 Iceberg 、数据湖、实时数仓等相关经验。  
有大型风控规则引擎、实时决策引擎或事件驱动系统建设经验。  
有大型企业基础设施平台、统一接入平台、监控平台或内部 PaaS 平台建设经验。  
有 AI Agent 、RAG 、MCP 、AI Coding 或其他 AI 工程实践经验。

Paid working trial for finalists**

## About AutoGPT

At AutoGPT, we're building toward a future where **AI agents do real work for
people** — not just answer questions, but take action, complete tasks, and
move work forward.

Our mission is to democratize AI by making powerful digital assistants
accessible and useful to everyone, regardless of technical background. We
created one of the most-starred open-source projects on GitHub, and our hosted
platform is now live and accepting paying customers.

We already have a large global audience and tens of thousands of branded
search visitors every month. What we don't yet have is a proven, repeatable
go-to-market motion.

**That's what you'll find.**

## The Product

  * **AutoPilot:** an AI teammate that builds and runs working automations from a conversation.

  * **AutoGPT Builder:** a graph-based canvas for creating agents without coding.

  * **AutoGPT Marketplace:** discover and deploy ready-made agents.

  * **Agent Library:** manage, schedule, and monitor agents.

Try it in 60 seconds, no signup required: platform.agpt.co/tour/chat

## The Role

**Your mandate is to find, prove, and begin scaling a repeatable path from an
ICP-fit prospect with an urgent job to an activated, retained AutoGPT
customer.**

You'll investigate and fix the constraint wherever it exists: ICP selection,
positioning, proof, pricing, website conversion, checkout, onboarding,
activation, lifecycle communication, product experience, or acquisition.

This isn't a role where you deliver recommendations to another marketing team.
**You'll personally research, write, build, launch, measure, and iterate** ,
with direct access to the founders, product, engineering, and customer and
funnel data.

## What You'll Own

  * Establish reliable measurement from acquisition through purchase, activation, and retention.

  * Interview customers, non-buyers, churned users, and high-fit waitlist members.

  * Validate or disprove our ICP and use-case hypotheses.

  * Define the initial ICP, anti-ICP, JTBD, buying trigger, and value proposition.

  * Improve positioning, use-case pages, proof, checkout, and onboarding.

  * Help define and improve activation and time to value.

  * Launch segmented waitlist campaigns.

  * Run controlled paid-search tests around high-intent, non-branded problems.

  * Validate SEO opportunities before scaling content.

  * Test product-led social, YouTube, outreach, or partnerships where evidence supports them.

  * Work directly with product and engineering on funnel and activation improvements.

  * Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with hypotheses, costs, results, and decisions.

  * Provide concise weekly reporting: one async memo and one 30-minute decision meeting.

  * Protect and elevate the AutoGPT brand throughout.

## What Success Looks Like

**Within 10 business days:**

  * A reliable view of the funnel, including qualified traffic and meaningful product activation.

  * Evidence explaining the biggest current drop-offs.

  * Customer and high-fit non-buyer interviews completed.

  * Initial improvements or experiments already live.

  * Numeric targets agreed for the remainder of the contract.

**By the end of the engagement:**

  * ICP and use-case hypotheses validated or rejected.

  * Qualified conversion and/or activation and retention improved.

  * Acquisition sources that produce genuinely valuable customers understood.

  * The beginnings of a repeatable acquisition + activation motion — or compelling evidence identifying and addressing a more fundamental constraint.

  * A documented growth operating system and clear recommendation for what comes next.

**The primary outcome isn't more traffic. It's more ICP-fit customers who
successfully use AutoGPT and remain customers.**

## Who We're Looking For

You've personally operated in an early-stage product-led B2B or prosumer SaaS
environment — perhaps as a first or second growth hire, founding marketer,
hands-on growth lead, product-growth operator, or former founder.

You can demonstrate:

  * Relevant 0-to-1 growth results, including the starting baseline.

  * Exactly what you personally did — real pages, emails, ads, onboarding flows, dashboards, or research.

  * Strong customer-research and product-marketing judgment.

  * Analytical self-sufficiency across attribution, billing, and product data.

  * Experience improving onboarding, activation, or retention.

  * Ability to write and ship landing pages, emails, ads, and lifecycle communication.

  * Hands-on paid-search and experimentation experience.

  * Excellent written English and strong brand judgment.

  * Ability to work autonomously and communicate concisely.

Experience with AI, automation, developer tools, no-code products, or open-
source communities is useful, but **evidence that you've solved this kind of
commercial problem matters more.**

## This Is Not

  * An adviser-only fractional CMO role.

  * A strategy-deck engagement.

  * A pure paid-acquisition role.

  * An SEO content-production contract.

  * A social-media management role.

  * An agency account-management role.

  * A position for someone who needs a full design, analytics, and marketing team before shipping.

**Agency applications aren't suitable. We want the individual who will
personally do the work.**

## Why AutoGPT?

You'll own the commercial growth problem at a pivotal moment: a famous brand,
a live product, an existing audience, and a genuinely open playing field.

You'll have direct access to the founders, fast decisions on experiments, and
no approval bureaucracy for agreed reversible tests.

We're a small, kind, globally distributed team that values empathy, autonomy,
and shipping. What you prove during this engagement can become the company's
long-term growth engine.

## Details

**Role:** Contract GTM Lead (0-to-1)  
**Term:** Initial 12 weeks, approximately 3 days/week  
**Location:** Fully remote, async-first, with meaningful European working-hour
overlap  
**Rate:** £500–£650/day, depending on evidence and experience  
**Start:** Immediate  
**Selection:** Finalists complete a paid working trial

## How to Apply

**The application takes approximately 10 minutes.**

Apply here: <https://tally.so/r/QK94p8>

We'll ask for:

  1. Two relevant examples of early-stage growth work, including the starting position, problem, your personal contribution, what you shipped, results, and what didn't work.

  2. An example where an apparent acquisition problem turned out to be a different funnel, product, or positioning problem.

  3. What you'd need access to in your first week.

  4. Your availability, time zone, day rate, and number of other active clients.

  5. A short recording after trying AutoGPT, covering the biggest unknown you'd investigate, the first metric you'd establish, and one thing you'd deliberately avoid doing prematurely.

We assess candidates on **relevant evidence, analytical judgment, hands-on
execution, customer and product-marketing ability, brand judgment, and
autonomy.**

接入、模型评测、开发者支持或模型供应商协作经验者优先。

dreamers, adventurers, and world travelers passionate about what we do and
what we believe in. And we are ready for another talented person to join the
party.

understanding of technology and a passion for enabling other teams. This is a
role where your main customers are engineers and internal teams. You’ll work
on the shared foundations and capabilities that other teams rely on to build
and ship quickly, reliably, and at scale. Join us now.

making them happen—solving exciting challenges and driving changes that keep
our own product-engineering teams stay fast and reliable, and our customers
successful.

_

# **Who We Are**

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits,
wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with
and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about
our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on
running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop
iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment,
are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it,
we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are
best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and
in our team.

[Our Values](https://www.justworks.com/careers#values)

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

# **Who You Are**

Leadership comes naturally to you. You put your people before all else, and
are always thinking about how to develop their skills, provide them with new
experiences, and grow their sales knowledge. You are hardworking, persistent,
and a dependable natural leader who knows how to motivate and maintain a high
performing team while being positive and enthusiastic. You are analytical and
will not make decisions unless you have the numbers to back up those
decisions. You love building, executing, and hitting sales plans to achieve
and surpass expectations. You have a strong track record of exceeding results
and iterating to improve processes. It truly excites you to grow a new
business unit and solve real problems.

As the Manager of Account Development, you will be responsible for driving a
significant portion of the company's revenue from our existing customer base,
help build and motivate a great team, and develop others in a meaningful way.
You will have the ability to question the effectiveness of current processes
and procedures in order to lead change to increase the efficiency of our sales
force. You will work closely with lifecycle marketing, revenue effectiveness,
and CSO to shape strategies to reach our customers more effectively and create
more value in their Justworks experience.

# **Your Success Profile**

## **What You Will Work On**

  * Coach, hire, mentor, motivate and lead a team of Account Development Executives
  * Help develop and train the future leaders and top performers of the company
  * Manage day-to-day performance of all sales team members and deliver reviews
  * Embody company culture and maintain high sales employee engagement
  * Work cross-functionally with Lifecycle Marketing, Revenue Effectiveness, CSO, and other departments to shape customer outreach strategies
  * Track team metrics and report data and forecasts to leadership on a regular basis
  * Ensure correct usage of CRM and other sales applications
  * Maintain and grow a standard of excellence
  * Work with internal teams to improve processes, positioning, and strategies with an eye toward improving ability to upsell/cross sell
  * Lead and schedule weekly team meetings with sales team and leadership
  * Meet predetermined team goals through the activities of direct reports
  * Collaborate across teams to support upselling and cross-selling customers

## **How You Will Do Your Work**

As a Manager of Account Development, _how_ results are achieved is paramount
for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In
this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal
attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

  * **Good judgement** \- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.
  * **Detail-oriented** \- exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.
  * **Foundational sales knowledge** \- the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a person possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.
  * **Results-driven** \- consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.
  * **Clear communication** \- the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core
values known as COGIS. It stands for:

  * **Camaraderie** \- Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
  * **Openness** \- Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
  * **Grit** \- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
  * **Integrity** \- Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. 
  * **Simplicity** \- Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

## **Qualifications**

  * Minimum of 3 years of sales and/or upsell experience in a closing role
  * Minimum of 2 years of management experience preferred
  * Multi-language skills are a plus
  * You love data - you make decisions that are backed up by the numbers
  * You have strong interpersonal skills
  * Exceptional written and oral communication skill
  * Familiarity with forecasting
  * Growth-mindset
  * Hardworking, persistent, and dependable
