### This position offers $100K guaranteed minimum with uncapped commissions
selling a $6,400 business consulting offer to leads who were generated
primarily through Meta ads

Please do not apply unless you can provide real numbers from your previous
sales roles.

During the interview process, be prepared to walk us through how many calls
you took, how many sales you made, what the offer cost, where the leads came
from, how much revenue you personally closed, and exactly how your close rate
was calculated.

**\-----**

Dear future sales rep,

We're searching for someone who is incredible at turning skeptical strangers
into clients by truly understanding what is happening in their business,
helping them see what needs to change, and guiding them through the fears and
objections keeping them stuck.

Most of our prospects first discover us through Meta ads. By the time they
reach your calendar, they have applied to speak with us and have some
familiarity with our company, but most are still cold or lukewarm.

You will need to earn their trust.

You will need to diagnose the real problem.

You will need to help qualified prospects make a clear decision instead of
letting them run back to the same habits that have kept their business stuck
for years.

This role is a top priority at 6 Figure Creative because our entire company
exists to help creative freelancers solve one giant problem:

**They have no idea where their next client is coming from.**

Everything we do is designed to help them solve that problem permanently by
building a repeatable client acquisition system.

We're an established, profitable company doing roughly $2.5 million in annual
revenue, with a consistent paid acquisition engine generating sales
opportunities primarily through Meta ads.

We know there is significantly more upside available with the right person in
this seat, so we're looking for a proven closer who can help us raise the bar
for the entire sales team.

### Why we are offering a $100K guaranteed minimum

Most remote sales jobs throw out a giant OTE number, give you no guarantee
whatsoever, and make you absorb all the risk of joining a company you have
never worked with before.

We are doing something different.

We want someone with a real, documented track record who already has other
options.

We also understand that joining a smaller sales team is a risk. You do not
know yet how good our leads are, how strong the offer is, how the company
operates, or whether the opportunity is as good as we say it is.

So we are taking most of that downside off your plate.

You will receive a guaranteed minimum of $100,000 per year while keeping the
full upside of our existing uncapped commission structure.

To be completely clear, this is not a $100,000 salary plus commissions.

Each month, you receive **whichever amount is greater:**

  * $8,333.33 in guaranteed compensation
  * The commissions you earned that month

**There is no negative draw balance.**

**You never owe the guarantee back.**

**If your commissions exceed the guarantee, you receive the higher commission
amount.**

The guarantee does not mean the performance standard is lower. It means we are
willing to take a real financial risk to attract someone capable of raising
it.

If you are looking for a comfortable $100,000 job where you can close 15% of
your calls and hide, this is not that job.

If you perform at the level your track record suggests, the guaranteed minimum
should eventually stop mattering because your commissions will be higher.

### What You'll Do

As our Remote High-Ticket Closer, your primary responsibility is converting
qualified prospects into clients for our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting
Sprint.

You will conduct consultative enrollment calls over Zoom, diagnose the
prospect's business challenges, determine whether they are a strong fit,
clearly explain how we can help, and confidently ask qualified prospects to
enroll.

These are not random cold calls.

The prospects have applied to speak with us, but most were originally
generated through paid Meta ads and will not arrive fully sold.

Once a prospect lands on your calendar, you own that opportunity from
preparation through follow-up and final decision.

**Your main responsibilities include:**

### 1: Enrollment calls:

You will spend most of your time helping prospects determine whether our
consulting sprint is right for them.

If they truly need our help and are a strong fit, you should see it as your
responsibility to help them make the decision instead of allowing fear,
uncertainty, or a weak objection to send them back to the same situation they
wanted to escape.

**That means you will:**

  * Review every application before the call
  * Diagnose the real issues inside the prospect's business
  * Understand their goals, urgency, financial situation, and readiness
  * Determine whether they are a strong fit for our consulting sprint
  * Clearly explain our process, expectations, and investment
  * Make a direct recommendation when you believe they should enroll
  * Handle objections with empathy, patience, and confidence
  * Disqualify prospects who are not a good fit
  * Avoid enrolling obvious red-flag or high-risk clients just to hit a sales number

### 2: CRM and lead ownership

You will take complete ownership of every lead assigned to you inside
GoHighLevel.

No qualified opportunity should be lost because of weak follow-up, incomplete
notes, or an unclear next step.

**That means you will:**

  * Keep every opportunity stage accurate
  * Complete detailed notes after every call
  * Record the outcome and next step for every prospect
  * Complete all required follow-up on time
  * Reschedule qualified prospects who miss their calls
  * Work no-shows through our recovery process
  * Continue following up until the prospect enrolls, declines, or is formally closed out
  * Keep your sales data accurate enough that we never have to guess what is happening inside your pipeline

### 3: Call review and improvement

Every enrollment call is recorded.

You should already be excellent at sales when you join us. Call review here is
about sharpening strong performance, identifying patterns, testing better
approaches, and turning individual wins into improvements the entire sales
team can use.

You will regularly review your own calls, participate in team call reviews and
roleplay, and bring useful insights from your conversations back to the rest
of the company.

**That means you will:**

  * Review your own calls and identify specific areas to improve
  * Bring useful wins, losses, and difficult calls to team call reviews
  * Give and receive direct, thoughtful feedback
  * Test new approaches instead of relying on the same script forever
  * Apply what we learn to future calls
  * Help identify patterns in objections, lead quality, messaging, and offer positioning
  * Share what is working so the entire sales team improves alongside you

### **4: Improve the company's sales process**

You will work closely with me, the founder, to continuously improve our offer,
messaging, scripts, follow-up, and overall sales process.

You are talking directly to the market every day. That makes your feedback
extremely valuable.

**You will help us:**

  * Identify recurring objections and concerns
  * Find weaknesses in our messaging or offer
  * Improve our enrollment call structure
  * Improve email and text follow-up
  * Reduce the time between the first call and the final decision
  * Share useful insights with our marketing and consulting teams
  * Build a stronger sales system for everyone who joins after you

### What Success In This Role Looks Like

**We are hiring someone who can raise the bar, not just hit the current one.**

Within six months, the expectation is that you are handling approximately 70
to 80 completed sales calls per month and maintaining a 30% or greater close
rate.

A 35% or greater close rate would be exceptional.

We expect a fast ramp:

  * 9 or more new clients in your first full production month
  * 12 or more in your second full production month
  * 15 or more in your third full production month

Your first-year target is at least 225 new clients, with 250 or more as the
goal.

### Who you'll work with

You will report directly to me (Brian Hood), the founder and person writing
this job description.

You will also work alongside a veteran closer who has been with the company
for 3+ years.

We are not a 40-person boiler room where you are handed a script, dropped into
a Slack channel, and treated like rep number 37.

You will have direct access to the person who can actually change the offer,
marketing, script, follow-up process, or sales system when something is not
working.

### See what you'd be selling

This role is easier to evaluate when you can see the actual offer and the
proof behind it.

  * [Review the Clients By Design program overview](https://downloads.6figurecreative.com/Brochures/Clients%20By%20Design%20Overview%20v1.2.PDF)
  * [See what clients have produced from their paid-ad campaigns](https://lp.6figurecreative.com/leaderboard)

### Why apply for this job?

If you're an experienced sales rep who wants to use your skills to help
transform the lives of creatives who run freelance businesses, this job might
be the perfect fit for you.

Our clients include Grammy-winning music producers, designers, videographers,
and other creative freelancers.

Despite being extremely talented at their craft, they have never been taught
how to consistently find and close clients.

The decision you help them make on a sales call can completely change their
career.

Not only will you be affecting the lives and businesses of the people you
enroll in our consulting program, but you'll also be impacting each and every
client _they_ work with as well.

**If you're a high performer who's been stuck in a toxic sales team** and you
want to help create a healthy, thriving sales culture, you'll love being able
to help us build out the sales team from the ground up and set the right
culture from day one.

**If you've spent years selling products you don't believe in** , this is an
opportunity to use your talent on something that genuinely helps people build
better businesses and lives.

**If you are tired of being one of dozens of closers** with no influence over
anything upstream, you will have direct access to the founder and a real voice
in how we improve the company.

**If you want the upside of commission without gambling your income** while
learning a completely new company, offer, and lead source, that is exactly why
we created the guaranteed minimum.

### Where you'll work

Our entire company operates remotely, with a diverse team spread across the
United States, Portugal, England, Romania, Israel, and South Korea.

You can work from home, a quiet coworking space, or anywhere else with
reliable internet and a professional place to take calls.

**You must be available to take calls during U.S. business hours** and have a
setup where prospects will not hear dogs barking, roommates yelling, or a
coffee grinder running during their enrollment call.

### What We Do At 6 Figure Creative (And Why We Do It)

6 Figure Creative is a business consultancy for creative freelancers who are
stuck relying on referrals, word of mouth, inconsistent content, or last-
minute desperate outreach to find clients.

Our mission is to help creatives earn more without selling their souls.

Our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint helps freelancers build and
implement a repeatable system for attracting and closing clients.

We believe that the education system is fundamentally broken. **Universities
will gladly charge their students $100k+ for a creative degree and**
_**never**_**teach them the most important skills and strategies for how to
actually get an ROI from their investment.**

The consulting program you'll be selling exists to help the best creatives in
the world change the trajectory of their careers (and lives) by learning the
skills universities failed to teach them.

It takes more than passion to succeed, and everything we do is built around
giving our clients the strategies, tools, processes, guidance, consulting, and
accountability they need to have successful businesses.

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply below.

I look forward to working with you!

_\- Brian Hood, Founder_

rep-scorecard) for this role

video](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/vlw0zfgm6qk4btejm1dyu/6FC-Culture-
Video.mp4?rlkey=adh6e0diewgsm39xf72lm686s&e=1&dl=0) about what it's like to
work here

###

**Requirements**

### Required Qualifications:

  * You have 3+ years of high-performance phone or Zoom sales experience, ideally selling coaching, consulting, agency services, education, or another high-ticket offer
  * You have personally closed at least $3 million in revenue, including at least $1 million during a single 12-month period
  * You have experience selling offers in or near the $6,000 to $10,000 range
  * You have documented experience closing cold or lukewarm prospects generated through direct-response Meta or YouTube ads
  * You can provide real numbers from previous roles, including call volume, sales volume, close rate, offer price, lead source, and revenue closed
  * You have maintained a 30% or greater close rate over a meaningful sample of held sales calls and can clearly explain how that close rate was calculated
  * You are willing to complete a live sales roleplay and provide professional references who can verify your performance
  * You consistently maintain accurate CRM records, call notes, follow-up, and next steps without needing to be chased

### Availability and Logistics

  * You can keep at least 35 bookable sales-call slots open each week.
  * You can live anywhere, but you must reliably work during agreed U.S. business hours and communicate fluently and professionally in English.

### Preferred Qualifications:

  * You understand digital marketing and client acquisition
  * You have sold business coaching or consulting offers to entrepreneurs, freelancers, or small-business owners
  * You have experience working with creative professionals
  * You have experience with short sales cycles involving one or two calls
  * You have worked inside a founder-led company
  * You enjoy improving scripts, sales systems, and the performance of the people around you
  * You are interested in helping build a high-performing sales team as the company grows

**Benefits**

  * $100,000 guaranteed minimum compensation
  * Uncapped commissions
  * 100% remote work
  * Flexible time off
  * Monthly house-cleaning service
  * $1,000 annual home-office upgrade allowance
  * Direct access to the founder
  * A real opportunity to influence the offer and sales process

### Compensation

You will receive the greater of your guaranteed monthly compensation or the
commissions you earn that month.

  * $100,000 annually

  * Nonrecoverable
  * No negative balance

At our current payment mix:

## An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI
strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person
responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org
operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest
challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way
of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows
today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritising what gets built and
in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also
prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before
pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI
team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process
intelligence, and strategic prioritisation. They bring the technical depth,
production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working
solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer
on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

## What you'll do

### Strategy & Prioritisation

  * **Own your function's AI strategy,** aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  * **Map how work flows** across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  * **Manage intake** of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  * **Prioritise strategically** against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

### Adoption & Change Management

  * **Reimagine, not just automate.** Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  * **Drive adoption and change management** together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  * **Coordinate with Enterprise AI** to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  * **Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.** Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.

### Hands-On Building & Agent Operations

  * **Build AI agents** using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.
  * **Author and iterate on skills files** that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.
  * **Configure MCP servers and tools,** giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.
  * **Own your function's fleet of agents.** Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.
  * **Expect to rebuild.** AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.

## What you'll bring

### Business & Strategic

  * **Deep knowledge of your function's operations.** You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.
  * **Strategic prioritisation skills.** You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.
  * **A product management mindset.** You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.
  * **Strong communication and influence.** You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.
  * **Cross-functional instincts.** You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.
  * **Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.** You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion programme owner, or community organiser. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.

### Hands-On & Technical

  * **Comfortable building with AI tools.** You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.
  * **Ready to learn fast.** Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.
  * **Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities** \- summarisation, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.
  * **Ability to map data flows** \- structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.

## About the team

You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology &
AI organisation, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI
provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You
provide the business context, prioritisation, building at the no-code layer,
and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI
transformation.

satisfaction, adoption, and customer retention.

· Proactively identify solutions & overcome barriers to satisfaction

stakeholders, a true customer-facing advocate with the skills and passion of a
project manager

proactively identify trends & potential risks, and to provide greater
visibility to the internal organization about the customer and their needs

escalations, while partnering with the Customer Support internal liaison

successful overall customer relationship

· A bachelor’s degree or equivalent

· 4+ years of relevant experience in customer success in a SaaS environment

· Experience working in healthcare technology

· Excellent project management skills

experience

· Comfortable understanding and explaining software products to diverse
audiences

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills

· Excellent project management skills, time management, and ability to remain
calm and resilient in high pressure situations

· High energy level, enthusiastic, and eager to do what is necessary to be
successful

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at [Customer.io](http://Customer.io). I'm
looking for an experienced engineering leader to own several of
[Customer.io](http://Customer.io)'s product development engineering teams.
This is a role for someone whose primary job is business impact: you set clear
goals, hold teams accountable to schedules, and personally drive complex
initiatives to done. Your first mandate is a high-priority, executive-visible
platform initiative — the kind of project where you'll set the direction,
align the org, and carry it across the finish line yourself. If you're
energized by making things happen inside an organization — not just managing
the people who do — this role is for you.

## About [Customer.io](http://Customer.io)

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our
platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and
SMS every day. [Customer.io](http://Customer.io) powers automated
communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral
data. Under the hood: Go, React and AI help us ship fast and scale with
confidence.

## What We Value

**Execution above all**  
Leading a team and driving impact are not the same job — yours is the second
one, and the team is how you do it. You set direction, create accountability,
and see initiatives through across an organization. When something must ship,
you put it on your back.

**Engineering leaders who go deep and wide**  
You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You
can align executives on a roadmap and earn an engineering team's respect in
the same day. You still read the code, join the incident channel, and know why
the thing is late. You don't choose between vision and execution — you hold
both.

**A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"**  
You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter — but never more than
forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait.

**An AI-first engineering mindset**  
AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You've
developed a real point of view on AI-native development, you can speak to it
concretely, and you bring it into how your org operates.

## What You'll Do

  * Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for major platform initiatives — starting with the delivery of our new billing platform, a high-visibility integration program spanning Engineering, Product, and Finance
  * Set clear goals and delivery milestones, hold teams accountable to them, and communicate progress crisply to executive stakeholders
  * Make build-vs-buy and sequencing decisions with conviction, and lead the team through them
  * Mentor and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders — with the bar that everyone on the team can articulate the impact they're driving
  * Drive a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the org
  * Leverage AI tools to accelerate team velocity and bring an AI-native perspective to how the team builds

## What We're Looking For

  * 12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time leading engineering teams
  * Experience managing engineering managers and/or senior technical leaders
  * A track record of driving complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion — you've taken something ambiguous and org-spanning and personally made it ship
  * Deep understanding of SaaS software architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that come with building in-house vs. buying and integrating
  * Ability to translate technical complexity into clear strategy and communicate effectively with both engineers and executives
  * Demonstrated AI-native leadership — not just personal fluency, but a track record of bringing AI-first development practices into how your team works
  * Comfort operating in ambiguity and making difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities
  * You can articulate, specifically, what you made happen in your last role that wouldn't have happened without you

**Bonus points for:**

  * Experience in the domains of self-service and growth, audience segmentation, or customer data platforms (CDPs)
  * Exposure to billing, subscriptions, or monetization systems — useful context for your first mandate, not a requirement
  * Experience at high-growth SaaS companies; you have delivered results at a startup
  * Track record of shipping in high-velocity product orgs where your domain was treated as a first-class engineering concern

## Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $230,000-$270,000
USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to
market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great
care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and
growth, including **100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health,
and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family**. We also offer
**16 weeks paid parental leave** , **unlimited PTO** , stipends for remote
work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

[See full benefits here
→](https://customer.io/careers#:~:text=our%20collective%20success.-,BENEFITS,-Our%C2%A0)

## Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help
both of us make an informed decision.

  1. **Application** \- We review everyone with care.
  2. **Recruiter Call (30 mins)** \- Let's chat about what you're looking for, your leadership style, and how we work.
  3. **Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins)** \- Deep dive into your experience leading teams, your technical philosophy, and how you think about building organizations.
  4. **People Partner Interview (60 mins)** \- Explore your leadership style, management philosophy, and approach to supporting high-performing teams with our engineering people partner.

As our **Sr. Demand Generation Manager** , you'll be essential in achieving
TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job.
You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google
Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that
turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make
a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes
pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as
TestGorilla scales.

# Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  * Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  * Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets.

  * Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots.

  * Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor.

  * Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions.

  * Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language.

  * Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins.

# What you’ll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  * Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  * Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  * Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment.

  * Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS.

    * _We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far._

  * Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager.

  * Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite.

  * Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly.

  * Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use.

  * Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that
women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet
every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience
doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply.

While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from
you if you have:

  * Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution.

  * Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM.

  * Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget.

  * Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels.

  * Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool

on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring

网关、大模型智能路由、上下文管理、智能体原生支付协议等资源层服务。我们的客户是智能体开发者和智能体本身。我们的愿景是构建”Amazon for AI

能力。

## 1 、后端工程师

我们正在招聘一位 动手能力强的工程师，一起参与核心平台的建设和维护。这个岗位以 后端 / 全栈开发
为主，也会涉及部分平台运营相关工作，例如模型上线、价格更新，以及 API 、agent skills 和 plugins 的开发。
你将负责参与平台前后端功能的开发与维护、开发 API 、agent skills 、plugins 及相关集成能力负责系统维护、问题排查和线上运行支持

使用过 Claude Code 、Codex 、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具

## 2 、开发者关系工程师

AIsa 正在构建面向 Agent 时代的基础设施——从统一的资源层（ API 、LLM 、Skill 、Connector ）到可控的 Agent
运行时与控制平面，致力于打造一个开发者可以自由上传、组合、计费资源的开放生态。

作为 AIsa
的首位开发者关系工程师，你将是我们与中国开发者社区之间的核心纽带。你需要把复杂的平台能力转化为开发者能轻松上手的内容：清晰的文档、跑得通的示例、有价值的开源项目，以及真实的社区口碑。

在技术社区的“门面”。我们需要你懂技术、善表达，更要懂开发者。

AIsa 目前处于早期阶段。你不会接手一套成熟的体系，而是要从第一篇文档、第一个示例、第一批开发者开始，亲手搭建起我们的开发者生态。如果你享受“从 0 到
1”的过程，并坚信 Agent 基础设施的未来，这会是一个充满挑战与成就感的位置。

你的核心目标是降低中国开发者使用 AIsa 平台的门槛，建立技术口碑，并形成有效的产品反馈闭环：

AIsa 的技术声誉。

Meetup 或技术大会分享经验。

•产品同理心 具备产品意识，能从开发者视角发现体验断点，并将吐槽转化为结构化反馈；极强自驱力。加分项：有 DevTool/API 平台的 Dev Rel

设计主智能体与子智能体的分发架构（意图识别、任务拆解、技能选择、跨智能体协同）；构建集群式并行协作；将执行轨迹沉淀为可复用技能，建立技能库自动合并与优化机制。

TapNow - 欢迎各位英雄好汉加入！

TapNow 是一个面向专业创作者的 AI
原生工作平台。我们的目标不是做一个单点工具，而是围绕真实创作项目，重新设计从灵感、素材、协作、生成到交付的完整工作流。

1\. TapTV：面向内容消费与创作者连接的新产品方向。  
2\. Creative OS：面向真实创作项目的 AI
原生工作系统，围绕无限画布、上下文管理、创作流程编排和多模态生成，帮助创作者把复杂项目持续推进下去。

我们正在探索很多很有意思、也很有挑战的方向。比如，如何让 AI
真正进入创作流程，而不是停留在一个聊天框里；如何把无限画布、上下文、生成任务和项目资产组织成一个可持续迭代的工作空间；如何让创作者在 AI
时代拥有更高效、更自由、更专业的工作方式。  
  
在我们看来，AI 与无限画布结合的交互形态，正在成为新一代创作工具的重要基础。TapNow 很早就在这个方向上投入，也持续在产品和工程上推动它向前演进。  
  
所以，如果你也相信 AI 会重塑创作工具，相信新的交互范式会带来新的产品机会，并且希望参与一个从 0 到 1 、从 1 到 100

### Role Overview:

We're looking for an experienced**New Business Development Representative**
who knows how to create opportunities, not just wait for them.

This is a senior outbound role focused on building high-quality pipelines for
our Account Executive team, whom you will work with closely on a daily basis..
You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-channel
outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that have
meaningful revenue potential.

You'll have the autonomy and freedom to test messaging, refine outbound
strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality
over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create
meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.

### Main Responsibilities:

  
**1\. Outbound Pipeline Generation** : Build and manage outbound campaigns
targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise
organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach
channels.  
**2\. Account-Based Prospecting:** Research and prioritize high-value
accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop personalized outreach that
cuts through the noise.  
**3\. Multi-Channel Outreach:** Execute thoughtful cold and warm outreach
across LinkedIn,  
email, calling, and other channels to consistently generate qualified
meetings.  
**4\. Opportunity Qualification** : Understand prospect pain points, qualify
opportunities, and ensure every meeting handed to an Account Executive has a
strong likelihood of progressing.  
**5\. Pipeline Development:** Own your pipeline targets by generating
qualified opportunities that contribute directly to company growth and
revenue.  
**6\. Market Intelligence:** Continuously gather insights from prospects,
competitors, and the AI search landscape to improve messaging and identify new
opportunities.  
**7\. Process Improvement:** Help optimize outbound playbooks, messaging,
sequencing, and targeting as we continue to scale our sales motion.  
  

### Main Requirements:

**Must Have:**

  * 4+ years of outbound BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS ( MarTech, SEO, AI or Digital Marketing Solutions)

  * Proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound meeting or pipeline targets

  * Experience prospecting into mid-market and enterprise organizations

  * Strong LinkedIn, email, and cold-calling skills

  * Experience using tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, or similar outbound tools

  * Fluent English (C1+)

  * Self-starter who enjoys ownership in a fast-growing remote scale-up

  * Available to collaborate across EU and US time zones.

**Nice to have:**

  * Familiarity with Account-Based Sales (ABS) or Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  * Additional European languages

  * Experience building outbound campaigns from scratch.

###  
What OtterlyAI Offers:

  * €4,000/month base (B2B contractor arrangement)

  * Uncapped commission based on qualified pipeline and closed business

  * Remote-first - work from anywhere in Europe

  * Flexible schedule with overlap across Europe and US timezones

  * Direct collaboration with founders and sales leadership

  * Opportunity to help define and scale OtterlyAI's outbound motion

###  
Recruitment Process:

  1. CV and brief selection:   
When submitting your CV, please also include a short note of 3 - 4 paragraphs
covering:

  * Your most successful outbound campaign

  * The most creative way you've booked a difficult prospect

  * One insight about the future of AI search or SEO

  1. Video Call: If your CV and brief note aligns with our requirements, HR invites you for an initial video call.

  2. Interview with the CRO: A deeper discussion about your experience, sales methodology, and previous achievements.

  3. Challenge: Create an outreach strategy to high-tier leads for OtterlyAI prospects. 

  4. Final Interview: Meet the founders and discuss how you would help OtterlyAI scale.

yourself becoming the access point for all requests, or if your team's output

it proactively - not someone who thrives in chaos and sees every crisis as a
badge of honor.

\- An AI skeptic in a leadership seat. We expect our engineering leaders to
actively drive AI adoption on their teams, not wait to be convinced.

experience

descContent:
远程 AI 产品经理  
薪资范围：20-35K  
岗位职责  
产品规划与方向：基于用户需求、竞品和模型能力，定义产品形态、路线图和优先级，主动决定该做什么、不做什么——是规划者，不是既定需求的执行者。  
把 AI 能力转化为产品价值：持续判断大模型、生图、语音等能力的边界，识别哪些能力能变成真实的用户价值和商业机会，定出值得投入的方向。  
定义 AI 体验标准：模型输出不确定，你要定义"什么是好的 AI 表现"，建立角色人设、质量标准和评测方式，并管理 AI
出错时的体验，把"好的陪伴体验"变成团队可落地、可验收的目标。  
商业化与增长规划：设计产品的变现模式与增长策略，并把推理成本、延迟纳入产品决策（成本本身就是 AI 产品的设计变量），对付费、留存等核心经营指标负责。  
数据驱动迭代：建立指标体系，用数据和 A/B 实验判断方向、驱动迭代。  
跨职能推进：撰写 PRD 、排定优先级，推动工程、设计、运营落地。  
  
任职要求  
3 年以上 C 端产品经验，独立规划并落地过完整产品或核心模块；真实做过 AI / 大模型产品并对其体验负过责。  
理解大模型是概率系统：懂能力边界与典型问题，会用评测和迭代驱动质量，而不是当确定性功能来 spec 。  
强用户同理心和产品规划能力，能从零判断该做什么、为什么做。  
商业与成本敏感，理解用户付费心理，懂虚拟物品 / 会员 / 打赏 / 游戏化等变现设计。  
数据能力扎实，会定指标、拉数、设计实验。  
  
加分项  
深度玩过或研究过 AI 陪伴 / 角色扮演产品（ [Character.AI](http://Character.AI) 、星野、Candy AI
、酒馆等）或乙游。  
有出海、华人市场或社区 / 内容产品经验。  
懂二次元、网文，或对海外泛成人（ NSFW ）互动娱乐有理解和包容度。  
能自己用 AI 工具做原型、写 Prompt 、调模型表现。  
  
\-----------------------------  
远程产品经理  
薪资：20-30k  
一、岗位职责  
1\. 负责核心产品从 0-1 的规划、设计与落地，包括竞品调研、需求洞察、方案设计、功能验证等，确保产品从概念到上线的完整闭环。  
2\. 主导跨部门协作（设计、研发、运营等），推动项目按计划推进，并对最终结果负责。  
3\. 负责产品原型设计，熟练使用 Axure 等工具，能够输出高质量、逻辑清晰的交互原型，并具备一定的视觉审美与界面呈现能力。  
4\. 具备一定的团队管理经验，能够指导中初级产品成员开展工作，提升团队整体专业能力。  
5\. 跟踪产品上线后的数据表现和用户反馈，进行分析与迭代优化。  
6\. 具备较强的结构化思维能力，对复杂业务场景进行抽象和系统化设计。  
  
二、任职要求  
1\. 本科及以上学历，产品、计算机、设计等相关专业优先。  
2\. 5 年以上互联网/软件产品经理经验，至少具备 1 个从 0-1 独立负责并成功落地的项目经验。  
3\. 熟练使用 Axure 、墨刀、Figma 等原型工具，能独立完成 高保真交互原型设计，理解 UI/视觉基本规范及呈现逻辑。  
4\. 具备 业务理解能力与数据分析能力，能够将业务需求转化为可实现的产品方案。  
5\. 具备一定的 团队管理能力或带队经验，可以指导新人并进行工作拆解与质量把控。  
6\. 具备良好的沟通能力、推动能力和跨部门协作能力，能够在多方需求中进行合理取舍与决策。  
7\. 具备较强的文档能力，能够输出高质量的 PRD 、交互文档、需求分析等。  
8\. 抗压能力强，责任心强，具备较强的自驱力与主人翁意识。  
三、加分项  
1\. 有大型互联网公司产品经验者优先。  
2\. 有消费品、电商、社交、内容平台等行业经验者优先。  
3\. 具备用户增长、商业化等方向项目经验更佳。  
4\. 具备 UED/交互设计背景或视觉审美能力突出者优先。

who knows how to create opportunities, not just wait for them.

for our Account Executive team, whom you will work with closely on a daily
basis.. You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-
channel outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that
have meaningful revenue potential.

strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality
over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create
meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.

targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise
organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach

At OnTheGoSystems, we're building AI systems that help people translate
content across many languages. Our LLM team works with AI-generated
translations, user edits, customer feedback, and quality data to continuously
improve translation quality.

We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys solving open-ended problems,
finding patterns in complex datasets, and turning data into practical
recommendations. This is not a reporting role. You'll decide what to measure,
investigate why things happen, and help the team make better decisions based
on evidence.

## What you'll do

You'll own analytical problems from start to finish.

For example, you may discover that users edit translations much more often for
one language pair than another. Instead of simply reporting it, you'll
investigate why. You'll form hypotheses, gather the data, test possible
explanations, and recommend the next steps.

Your work will include:

  * Defining meaningful metrics for translation quality, AI performance, and user behavior.

  * Monitoring trends and identifying unusual patterns or quality issues.

  * Turning observations into structured investigations and testing multiple hypotheses.

  * Extracting and combining data from SQL databases, NoSQL databases, logs, APIs, and CSV exports.

  * Comparing results across language pairs, AI models, providers, customers, content types, traffic levels, and other dimensions.

  * Separating real signals from coincidence by validating findings with data.

  * Reviewing translation samples to confirm whether patterns represent genuine quality issues.

  * Investigating root causes and recommending practical improvements.

  * Evaluating multilingual AI output for meaning, terminology, tone, formality, grammar, pronouns, and consistency.

  * Using AI tools, dictionaries, and other resources to investigate languages you don't speak, while recognizing when expert linguistic input is needed.

  * Reviewing AI-generated analyses, identifying incorrect conclusions, and helping improve our automated evaluation systems.

  * Building repeatable reports, scripts, and monitoring processes.

  * Communicating findings clearly to developers, product managers, and linguists.

## What we're looking for

  * Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail.

  * The ability to work independently and define what should be investigated.

  * Experience turning open-ended questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.

  * A solid understanding of metrics, segmentation, distributions, correlations, and the difference between correlation and causation.

  * Experience writing SQL, Python, or similar scripts to collect, clean, and analyze data.

  * Experience working with multiple data sources, including databases, logs, APIs, and exported datasets.

  * Strong hands-on experience using AI tools while critically evaluating their output.

  * Fluent English plus at least one additional language (preferably European), with the ability to assess translation quality and explain language issues.

  * Clear written communication and the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical colleagues.

Bonus points for experience with:

  * Translation quality or localization.

  * Multilingual content.

  * Data visualization or business intelligence tools.

## Why join us?

You'll work on real AI systems used by customers around the world and directly
influence how we measure and improve machine translation quality.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring difficult questions,
testing ideas, and discovering insights that aren't immediately obvious.
You'll have the freedom to propose your own analyses and the responsibility to
turn them into evidence-based recommendations.

## What we offer

  * 100% remote position,

  * Body and Mind Movement program to fill you up with energy,

  * A computer budget to make your workplace better,

  * A Kindle device with access to our company Amazon account,

  * We respect national holidays in each country and want you to have a rest these days,

  * Great opportunity to progress and advance,

  * Collaborating with team members across the globe.

If you're excited by data, languages, AI, and solving complex problems, apply
now, and we'd love to hear from you!

We’re seeking a Front-End Developer who wants to make the world a better place
through clean code, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a genuine love of building
great websites.

This isn’t just about turning designs into code, it’s about translating ideas
into experiences, solving problems along the way, and taking pride in the
details that make a site feel right. This role is perfect for someone who
enjoys the craft of front-end development, cares about doing things the right
way, and is always looking for a better, more efficient way to build.

* * *

## Why work at Yoko Co?

  * **Do good, better:** We exclusively serve clients who make a positive impact on the world. This is your chance to build things that help create a better place for all of us.
  * **4-day flex week and lots of holidays.** Mondays are flex days, meaning you’re free to take them off if you’re caught up on your work. Plus, we’re closed for nearly a full week at Thanksgiving (November), and two weeks at the end of the year, plus a bunch of other days, too.
  * **High performance, no jerks.** You’ll collaborate with good people who believe in doing great work. Best Place to Work (and that’s not just our opinion).
  * We’ve been named a **Best Place to Work** by the Inc. 5000 and Washington Business Journal. We value team members who are motivated by our mission and driven to make a positive impact.

If you have a passion for excellence, a growth mindset, and a commitment to
collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

* * *

## What you’ll do:

As part of our development team, you’ll build websites and features from
design references, turning Figma files into clean, maintainable, production-
ready code. Our primary stack is built on Gutenberg block themes, so you’ll
spend most of your time there, though you may also work on traditional
WordPress themes and, occasionally, other page builders.

  * Build websites and site features from design references, using industry-standard code and best practices
  * Develop and maintain WordPress block themes using Gutenberg, templates, parts, patterns, and theme.json configuration
  * Work with traditional WordPress themes when needed, and occasionally with other page builder platforms
  * Write clean, well-structured HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  * Build or extend front-end functionality using React or similar component-based approaches when the project calls for it
  * Use Git and GitHub for version control, following team branching and code review conventions
  * Work within a continuous deployment workflow, ensuring changes move smoothly and safely from development to production
  * Troubleshoot cross-browser and cross-device issues to ensure consistent, polished results
  * Collaborate with designers, project managers, and strategists to bring projects to life
  * Look for new and more efficient ways to deliver our work, whether that’s through better tooling, reusable components, or refined processes
  * Contribute to internal documentation, component libraries, and knowledge sharing
  * Stay current with WordPress, Gutenberg, and front-end development trends and best practices

* * *

## What we’re looking for:

We’re less concerned with rigid checklists and more interested in capable,
thoughtful developers who care about quality and enjoy solving problems.
Strong candidates typically have:

  * Fluency in WordPress, with experience building both traditional themes and Gutenberg block themes
  * Comfort working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Experience translating design references (Figma or similar) into accurate, responsive, production-ready code
  * Familiarity with Git workflows and collaborative development practices
  * Experience working within a continuous deployment or CI/CD pipeline
  * Experience working with tools like Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex
  * An eye for detail and a commitment to clean, maintainable code Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  * Fluent English for written and spoken communication
  * Bonus points: 
    * Experience building custom Gutenberg blocks
    * Experience with React or similar component-based frameworks
    * Experience working in a multi-client or agency environment

* * *

## You may not want to apply if…

  * You prefer 100% concrete specs handed to you with no ambiguity and no changes. We do our best to provide final, locked designs and specs, but things inevitably change as a project progresses
  * You’re not interested in learning or working within Gutenberg block themes
  * You’d rather work solo than collaborate with designers, PMs, and strategists
  * You’re reluctant to incorporate AI into your workflow

Front-end development here is a mix of code and configuration, and often
requires curiosity, flexibility, and a willingness to find the most efficient
path to a great result.

* * *

## What you get:

You’ll get a flexible schedule, unlimited time off, a competitive salary, a
profit share bonus (starting in your second year), the ability to work
wherever you want, a personal development budget, and all US federal holidays
and multiple weeks off at the end of the year to recharge. We’ll also offset
your entire carbon footprint. If you’re in the US, we also offer health
insurance, disability and life insurance, and 401(k) matching.

* * *

## More about us:

We’re a group of people who are passionate about the work we do, the clients
we serve, and improving our craft. We also care about each other — we don’t
think of one another as coworkers or employees, but as fellow humans. From
developers to designers, project managers to strategists, we bring out the
best in each other.

We’ve been in business for over a decade, our whole team is remote, and we’ve
been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and the Washington Business
Journal.

* * *

## **To apply:**

If you’re interested, fill out our [application
form](https://form.jotform.com/240285232476052). An actual human from our team
looks at every submission. As much as we’d like to, we can’t promise that
we’ll reply to every application.

P.S. We encourage you to include a video message!

## About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading
Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance
history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship
end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI
marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables
marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate
creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data
Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify,
Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to
grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and
we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If
you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build
alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love
to meet you.

### **The Role**

Most AI-generated emails still look like AI-generated emails. Off-brand color,
clunky layouts, the same five templates on a loop. Brands that care about
their identity have stayed on the sidelines because the output hasn't met
their bar.

We're changing that. Hightouch's Agentic Marketing Platform is the system
enterprise marketers are using to plan, generate, and ship lifecycle campaigns
with their data, their guidelines, and their voice. Our customers include
Domino's, Chime, Spotify, Ramp, Whoop, and Grammarly. They are not going to
settle for slop, and neither are we.

**We're hiring an AI Creative Designer** to be the human who proves what's
possible. You'll collaborate alongside our Solutions Engineering team on
enterprise customer calls, translate brand guidelines into agentic workflows
that actually produce on-brand email and lifecycle creative, and ship the work
that makes the case. You will be the most influential creative voice in the
room, both for our customers and for our product.

You will define how the most recognizable brands in the world build email with
AI, and you will watch the work you direct ship to millions of inboxes.

### **What You’ll Do**

  * **Lead creative on enterprise engagements.** Partner directly with our customers' lifecycle and marketing teams to accelerate the adoption of our Agentic Marketing Platform through on-brand email systems that deliver immediate impact. Understand each brand's identity, engagement goals, and constraints. Build the agentic workflows, prompts, reference libraries, and guardrails that produce work the brand is proud to send.
  * **Set the creative bar.** When a customer asks "can your platform make an email that looks like _this_ ," you're the person who makes it look like that. You'll produce the creative work that turns curiosity into conviction and proves what's possible.
  * **Drive performance, not just aesthetics.** Partner with customers on A/B tests, iterate on creative based on results, and build the playbook for what drives opens, clicks, and conversions, and reliably lands in the inbox, when AI is in the loop.
  * **Shape the product.** As the creative voice closest to product and engineering, you'll spot friction, refine workflows, and help shape model behavior to directly influence what we build next!
  * **Define the playbook.** Document patterns that work, share them with the team, and build the body of knowledge that lets us scale taste across every customer we onboard.

### **What You Bring**

  * **A portfolio that does the talking.** Real lifecycle programs, real email campaigns, real product launches. Ideally with AI integrated into the workflow, but the bar is craft. If your work is exceptional, we want to see it. (Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.)
  * **Deep email design experience.** You've designed hundreds of emails across lifecycle programs (onboarding, nurture, retention, win-back) and you have sharp opinions about layout, hierarchy, and what renders well across clients and devices. Comfortable getting into the code and build of an email is a plus.
  * **Deep AI fluency.** You don't need us to teach you what's new. You're already testing the latest image and generative models the week they drop, you're stringing them together in node based UIs, you have strong opinions about which ones get which jobs, and you know how to push them past their defaults to hit a specific look.
  * **Enterprise client instincts.** You've worked directly with sophisticated marketing teams, in-house, agency, or consultancy, and you know how to navigate brand reviews, legal, and the politics of getting work approved.
  * **Lifecycle marketing literacy.** You understand the difference between an email that wins a design award and one that hits an engagement or revenue target, and you can hold both standards at once.
  * **Taste.** This is the hardest one to write a bullet for, so we'll just say it: you have it, your portfolio shows it, and you can articulate _why_ something works.

### **Why Hightouch?**

You'll be the creative center of gravity for a product that's actively
defining a category. The brands you'll work with are the ones you already
follow. The team you'll join, Product, Engineering, Solutions, Design, ships
fast and treats craft as a non-negotiable. And the work you do will compound:
every workflow you build, every customer you ship for, makes the next one
easier.

If you've been waiting for the moment to bet on AI in lifecycle marketing
before it's obvious, this is it.

### Compensation

$140,000-$180,000 USD per year, location-independent. Top of band is reserved
for candidates with proven enterprise creative leadership and a portfolio that
sets the bar. We also offer meaningful equity in the form of ISO options, with
early exercise and a 10-year post-termination exercise window.

your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form
I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of
Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify
to pre-screen applicants._

At its core, the AI Strategy Consultant role centers around driving marketing
strategy and transformation in enterprise organizations.

Today, most marketing communications are planned weeks in advance on a
calendar based on dates and internal priorities. Each email, push, campaign
takes 3-5 people and dozens of steps to create. Our customers come to us
looking to transform the way they do marketing: using AI agents to rapidly
learn about consumer preferences and deliver highly effective marketing and
product experiences to each customer 1:1.

As an AI Strategy Consultant, you are the****trusted technical–strategic
partner for our AI Decisioning customers. You own the bridge between what the
product can do and what the customer’s business needs — from discovery through
go‑live and expansion.

You’ll work with as a part of a driven and creative team of ML + product
engineers, product designers, and other Strategy Consultants to deploy new use
cases with the largest customer-facing brands in the world. Your mission is to
uncover the most impactful use cases for our customers, understand the
insights that are derived from the decision engine, and recommend to our
customers new campaigns or adjustments to achieve greater outcomes.

You’ll immerse yourself in our customer’s marketing organization. You’ll
partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product
landscape to help us scale. The problems you’ll work on require a curious and
analytical approach, sharp product intuition, and the ability to use insight
to improve decisions.

**No two days are the same, but you can expect to:**

  * Own all phases of AI Decisioning use case delivery working alongside Hightouch engineers, customer executives, marketers, and IT stakeholders
  * Run design sessions with customers to decide on and document use case requirements and improvements
  * Champion delivery & project management excellence through development of process playbooks and best practices
  * Proactively identify, escalate, and mitigate potential project risks
  * Build relationships with key stakeholders at Hightouch customers
  * Participate in driving the AI Decisioning product strategy

  * Experience working with Martech tools/CEMs/CDPs/etc.

  * Clear communicator: you are able to express yourself clearly and persuasively, both in writing and speech
  * Experience managing and executing technical projects with a customer-first attitude and a strong sense of empathy

## Bonus If You Have

  * Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL)

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals
who are interested in tackling the problems above. We focus on impact and
potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this

geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor iedereen toegankelijk te maken. Sinds onze
oprichting in 2013 zijn we uitgegroeid tot de grootste online therapie dienst
ter wereld, met betaalbare en toegankelijke therapie in meer dan 210 landen.

Ter voorbereiding op onze EU-lancering in Nederland zoeken wij gekwalificeerde
counselors en therapeuten om ons netwerk te versterken.

Sluit u aan bij het grootste online counseling platform ter wereld!

**Voordelen van werken bij BetterHelp:**

  * **Werk met een eersteklas organisatie** tijdens onze uitbreiding in Europa.
  * **Alles-in-één platform:** Voer uw sessies soepel uit zonder u zorgen te maken over klantwerving, facturatie of administratieve taken—wij nemen dat allemaal voor onze rekening!
  * **Flexibiliteit:** Geef therapiesessies vanaf elke locatie, ondersteund door een toonaangevend wereldwijd platform.
  * **Gespecialiseerde cliëntgroepen:** Richt u op de gebieden waar u het meest gepassioneerd over bent.
  * **Geen overheadkosten:** Er worden nooit kosten in rekening gebracht bij de counselor.
  * **Autonomie over klinische beslissingen:** U bent de gekwalificeerde en ervaren counselor. BetterHelp respecteert uw klinische oordeel en expertise om de meest effectieve en geschikte aanpak voor elke cliënt te bepalen.
  * **Ondersteuning en hulpmiddelen:** Counselors op het BetterHelp-platform ontvangen gratis toegang tot een BetterHelp-account – zodat u ook tijd kunt besteden aan uw eigen welzijn!
  * **Concurrerende vergoeding en bonussen:** Verdien €500 wanneer u uw eerste cliënt binnen 14 dagen na aanmelding accepteert. (Eerste-cliëntbonussen kunnen wijzigen, dus dit is het perfecte moment om u aan te sluiten!)

**Voor wie is dit van toepassing:**

  * Counselors die flexibiliteit zoeken om teletherapie vanaf elke locatie te geven.
  * Counselors die zich willen richten op klinisch werk—wij nemen de werving van cliënten, facturatie en ondersteuning voor onze rekening.
  * Counselors die graag werken met specifieke doelgroepen of problematiek.

  * Is gekwalificeerd om te praktiseren als WO-psycholoog, Integratief Counselor, Psychosociaal Counselor of Psychosociaal Therapeut.
  * Heeft minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in het begeleiden van volwassenen.
  * Is in staat om een vertrouwelijke en rustige omgeving te waarborgen voor het uitvoeren van therapiesessies.
  * Moet een achtergrondcontrole doorstaan.
  * Heeft een betrouwbare internetverbinding voor teletherapie.

_Belangrijk: Counselors zijn geen werknemers van BetterHelp, maar
onafhankelijke contractanten. Het gebruik van het woord "bonus" verwijst naar
een stimulans die wordt geboden aan onafhankelijke contractanten. Dit
impliceert geen dienstverband en geeft geen recht op werknemersvoordelen._

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era.
At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest
enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI
ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give
customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry
for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a
massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and
grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place
where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and
bring their full selves to the herd.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

Customer Advocacy at Cribl is all about turning customer success into momentum
for our customers, for our field teams, and for the market. The team helps
identify, shape, and activate real customer stories across sales, events,
brand, demand generation, community, and thought leadership so that customer
proof is easier to find, easier to use, and more impactful.

In this role, you’ll get hands-on experience bringing this work to life.
You’ll support projects that make customer proof more usable and reusable
across the business, including improving customer reference data and preparing
content for AI and LLM consumption. Additionally, you will have the
opportunity to build AI workflows that enable our GTM teams to move faster

CriblCon.

You’ll also get exposure to how a modern advocacy team operates cross-
functionally, strategically, and with a deep focus on customer value. At
Cribl, customer stories are not side assets; they are a core part of how we
build trust, credibility, and market momentum.

process development, program support, and exploratory work. You’ll have clear
guidance, exposure to the broader team, regular feedback, and the opportunity

You’ll leave with a stronger understanding of customer advocacy, cross-

  * Strong attention to detail and an instinct for organizing content, systems, and workflows.

## **An overview of this role**

As an AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll help build the foundation for GitLab's
transformation into an AI-first company. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise
AI, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for delivering internal
AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with
understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools,
and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is
the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take
ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering
skills with systems thinking and business understanding.

Your initial focus will span Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, where you
will embed AI solutions into key systems and workflows. This role offers the
opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the
organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and
values-driven environment.

## **What you'll do**

  * Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.
  * Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
  * Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.

  * Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.

  * Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.

## **What you'll bring**

  * **A Technologist at Heart -** Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energised by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.
  * **Competent, Confident Coding Skills -** You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.
  * **AI**** & LLM ****Technical Depth -** Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Deep, practical experience with modern AI technologies, specifically: Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.
  * **Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs:** understanding when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to make principled decisions about capability versus cost.

  * **AI Safety & Risk Awareness - **You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defences, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.
  * **Systems Thinking & Diagnostic Rigour - **The ability to look at a complex process and see the constraint. Comfortable mapping how work flows end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks, and tracing problems to root causes before proposing solutions. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?"
  * **Business System Expertise -** Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but to understand what they do, how they fit together, and be willing to build with and across them. A strong understanding of enterprise data models and workflows is essential.
  * **Broad Functional Understanding -** Ability to have meaningful conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains and quickly understand their unique needs.
  * **End-to-End Ownership -** Track record of owning complex initiatives from discovery through delivery. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving to measurable outcomes independently.

**About Sezzle:**

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is
revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge
tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter
and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining
how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while
driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher
order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re
building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just
a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about
pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for
consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the
future of shopping!

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a talented and motivated **AI Engineer II** who is best in
class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting
opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly
growing team, with strong prospects for continued growth and increased
ownership.

As an AI Engineer II on the Applied AI team, you will take on end-to-end
ownership of complex platforms and systems that power Sezzle's AI-driven
capabilities. Your work will span initiatives such as building AI-powered
platforms from scratch, developing intelligent automation and orchestration
systems, and embedding proprietary AI solutions directly into customer-facing
products, internal tools, and operational workflows.

You will operate in highly ambiguous problem spaces, working closely with
product, engineering, and operations teams to identify opportunities where AI
can drive meaningful impact — whether that's enhancing the customer
experience, improving decision-making, or automating complex workflows. This
role is ideal for engineers ready to move beyond scoped execution and into
leading solutions: shaping architecture, driving implementation, and ensuring
that what is built is reliable, scalable, and genuinely useful for both
external users and internal teams.

**What You'll Do:**

  * Lead the design, development, and ownership of AI-powered internal platforms and systems, including initiatives built from the ground up.
  * Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from problem discovery and system design through production rollout and iteration.
  * Design and implement AI-driven features, intelligent automation, and orchestration systems that enhance customer experiences and compound productivity across teams.
  * Embed AI capabilities into customer-facing products, internal tools, and operational workflows, ensuring solutions integrate naturally and deliver measurable value.
  * Build full-stack systems spanning backend services, APIs, data layers, and frontend interfaces.
  * Translate ambiguous business and operational problems into scalable, maintainable, AI-enabled technical solutions.
  * Apply strong systems thinking to ensure reliability, performance, security, permissions, and auditability across platforms.
  * Collaborate closely with engineers, teams, and stakeholders across the company to identify high-impact opportunities and drive adoption.
  * Participate in production support and incident response for owned systems, helping define and uphold reliability and operational best practices.
  * Mentor AI team members through code reviews, design feedback, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality bar of the team.

### **What We Look for:**

  * 3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering, **AI engineering** , platform engineering, or related roles.
  * **Hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping AI-powered systems** into production environments.
  * Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and frontend frameworks such as React.
  * Proven experience designing and owning production-grade full-stack systems.
  * Experience working with distributed systems, internal platforms, or complex data workflows.
  * Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  * Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and drive solutions with minimal direction.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  * Experience building AI-first platforms or internal products from scratch, including early architectural decisions.
  * Strong foundation in core machine learning and data science principles, including supervised/unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and statistical inference.
  * Experience with transformer architectures (BERT, GPT, etc.) and understanding of attention mechanisms, tokenization, and fine-tuning strategies for domain-specific applications.
  * Experience developing AI-assisted or agentic systems that interact with tools, data, or workflows.
  * Familiarity with embeddings and vector representations, including text embeddings, similarity search, and integration with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar).
  * Experience with NLP techniques including text classification, named entity recognition, semantic search, and information extraction.
  * Familiarity with cloud-native development using AWS.
  * Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM application patterns.
  * Experience with containerized systems and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (e.g., GitLab).
  * Experience with Golang is a plus (or willingness to learn).

**About You:**

  * **You have relentlessly high standards** \- many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  * **You’re not bound by convention** \- your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  * **You need action** \- speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  * **You earn trust** \- you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

**What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:**

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data
enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in
surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our
culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion
of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example
living in every employee that we hire.

The AI Transformation Owner drives the end-to-end AI agenda for the field

roadmaps, field use cases, and org-level strategy. You will partner closely

Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve
